reviews.text:
Food & service overall was very good.
I ordered a bearnaise sauce for my steak. Not sure what it was but definitely not bearnaise it was awful. 
I guess the chef dosen't know his sauces at all
reviews.author: M N.

reviews.text: The service, the view, the food, everything was top notch. I have never seen such thick asparagus before and it was cooked to perfection. I would definitely dine there again.
reviews.author: Kristin B.

reviews.text: Came here to celebrate my wife's birthday in Scottsdale and we were recommended J&G Steakhouse. We came at 5:00 PM and the ambiance of the restaurant was very good. Hotel decor was very nice and fashionable. The outdoor deck adjacent to the dining area is nice and has a great view of Scottsdale and Phoenix. Service staff were very friendly and attentive even though we were there early. My wife had the salmon and I had a boneless ribeye we had a tuna appetizer and auGratin potato's. Everything was prepared perfectly and was delicious. The staff prepared a chocolate soufflé for desert for my wife's birthday surprise along with a nice note from the staff. All the small details were really nice. I would recommend.
reviews.author: Richard L.

reviews.text: I was here for work a week or so back. A great place whose food is on par with the ambiance! Service was impeccable. The food tasted as good as it looked. There's really nothing negative I could say! The views at night are incredible at sunset. The entire dining area overlooks the resort in an elevated position. Amazing experience!
reviews.author: Samuel G.

reviews.text: Elegant steakhouse located on the 5th floor of the Phoenician Hotel! We celebrated my husband's birthday and our server Jose did not disappoint. Food was delicious and it was a great way to end our vacation. We had the ny strip and the wedge salad. Everything was cooked to perfection.
reviews.author: Patricia Z.

reviews.text: The food is always phenomenally prepared! The caviar and foie gras! Yum! Also the view is really gorgeous!
reviews.author: Crystal R.

reviews.text:
I have eaten at this resturant  several times. I went this past week and was disappointed. 
The food was good, but it seems the celebration  dessert  you will recieve has been downgraded. This was  only 6 months  ago.
reviews.author: Sara P.

reviews.text: Celebrated our 27th anniversary along with wife's 50th birthday service was amazing as was the food! Server made us feel super special which was much appreciated! Top shelf for sure!
reviews.author: Rick D.

reviews.text: Dinner was delicious! We ordered a big steak to share. I had the carrot salad with avocado and it was amazing. My husband had the soup. Service was great our server Austin was very attentive and delightful. Love this restaurant
reviews.author: Gail H.

reviews.text: Came for my birthday and Service was 15/10. Amazing views of the city and mountains. Warm hospitality and they really went above and beyond for us. The grass fed filet was so good it didn't even need the Bernaise sauce. Would come back for any big events.
reviews.author: Sydney B.

reviews.text: What a wonderful place to celebrate our 25th anniversary.  The staff was fantastic attentive and professional.  We had a window seat with a view of the valley lights.  My husband had the filet mignon perfectly cooked I had the grilled lobster delicious with a smokey flavor.  Our desert was gifted and consisted of molten chocolate cake with caramel ice cream.  Very pleasant meal.  It was our first visit and it won't be our last.
reviews.author: Elizabeth E.

reviews.text:
Can't beat the setting. The view at sunset was amazing.

Service was excellent, as you would expect. The apps were great... the tuna, truffle fries, and risotto. I had high expectations for the wagyu steak, but it was burnt, and I did not finish it.  The sticky toffee pudding was meh too and I did not finish it either.
reviews.author: Sunil R.

reviews.text:
This is a review of the Thanksgiving buffet. It was a major disappointment.

We last attended this Thanksgiving buffet 10 years ago and it was a foodies delight. Literally rooms of different foods, elegantly served and delicious. It's always been a family benchmark on a great meal. We thought it pricey at $90 per head, but were pleased with food, atmosphere and service.

We wanted to enjoy this location again and literally booked 90 days out to ensure we'd get our table for 4. Entering into the restaurant, I wondered where the rooms of food were as the rooms had been renovated

There were no rooms of food. A seafood station yielded tasteless shrimp and cracked crab claws. The oyster display was uninviting in their size.

A room with everything else had rwo carving stations for a small turkey breast and prime rib. 

The offerings were a major disappointment for the 2025 price of $175.00 per person!! Plus non-disclosure of a  20% service fee for buffet? Bill: $1081.00 for 4. Nah.

Not to return.
reviews.author: Dennis C.

reviews.text: Amazing service.  Amazing food.  And absolutely amazing views!!  We highly recommend!
reviews.author: Cindi K.

reviews.text: I was able to have a wonderful dinner with my daughter to continue celebrating my 50th birthday on our first night here at The Phoenician. Austin and Cory provided exceptional service. A beautiful venue with a stunning view! The meal was perfect! I highly recommend!
reviews.author: Kiki C.

reviews.text: There truly is no more exquisite view of the desert sunset than at J&G Steakhouse. Now add the delicious cuisine and superb service and you've got yourself an incredible experience you'll want to repeat again and again. The fresh seafood / the tuna tartare - the flavors in this one dish are like a symphony - and the truffle cheese fritters are beyond addictive! And the Mac & cheese - sooo good. Every dish cooked to perfection and paired with a wine that enhances the flavors perfectly.  Chocolate sorbet is a must to complete the meal. And I really don't even like chocolate. It was THAT decadent. I am truly in love with this restaurant and it's at the top of my list every time I'm in the area. 5 stars!!
reviews.author: Nancy G.

reviews.text:
Came here for dinner last night, the food was really really good! I had the shrimp to start, they were really fresh. Then had the 12oz fillet steak with broccoli, cooked to perfection! And managed to squeeze in a peach Melba desert which was equally as delicious.

Hunter our waiter was fantastic! The restaurant was beautiful, I really enjoyed the dim lighting, a very relaxing vibe. 

Thank you
reviews.author: Katie H.

reviews.text: We had a large dinner party of around 20 girls come on a Sunday. The service was great and prompt. The view from the restaurant is beautiful. I ended up going for the peppercorn steak which I ultimately regretted. The peppercorn was insanely overpowering and also had way too thick of chunks, so it was kind of inedible. I also ordered sides like the potatoes and mac & cheese, but unfortunately, they never made it to the table. I think they were forgotten. My friends, however, got the prefix menu which I was able to taste and actually really enjoyed. I thought their steak was a lot better than mine. Other than that, the drinks were really good and so is the company which was more important overall.
reviews.author: Bristol L.

reviews.text:
Staying at the Phoenician Canyon Suites and went to their onsite restaurant steakhouse last night.  French cheese fritters were outstanding!! Steak was prime and the absolute best.  We were there celebrating our anniversary and were seated at the window.  The sunset was stunning.  Then.....
Two couples came in with six children age ranging from what looked like 1-6.  They were seated at a long table; parents at one end and kids at the other.  Kids yelling screaming, crawling all over the table, running around and under their 
 table and then the tables nearest them in the restaurant and last, pushing a stroller around up and down that aisle.  All the while parents did absolutely nothing.  The area with loud children chatter and squealing was not my idea of a wonderful anniversary dinner for 2 .  Why children are taken to a high end restaurant is pure disrespect for others.  Unless they have been taught a level of decorum.  Can't expect that for AZ!  Anyway, In the end, we paid  $325 and the food service was painfully exceedingly slow.  It took more this 25 minutes for dessert to be delivered which was three scoops of coconut ice cream. Plan to spend your whole night when going there.  We arrived for a 645 reservation and left at 930.  We will never go back. So feel free to allow your establishment to turn into Chick E Cheese.
reviews.author: Rockie H.

reviews.text:
Excellent staff, food, and space. Plenty of seating, very spacious indoor and outdoor areas. You are paying for the views, the service, and the food. No complaints at all.

Chris and Christian were superb. Friendly, helpful, and very clearly patron-oriented. They knew how to serve our group, and checked in with us at perfect frequency (not overwhelming, yet attentive). 

Will need to come here to enjoy their establishment again.
reviews.author: Christian A.

reviews.text:
Excellent meal and service. I'm nit a steakhouse fan. I don't really care for fine dining TBH. I usually walk away still hungry and salty that the meal cost so much lol. This was not the case @ J & G.

We had dinner here and my husband had to twist my arm to agree to eat here. It had been a long time since I'd been to a really nice restaurant and I forgot how nice it was to have such great service. We were greeted and escorted by a lovely hostess to our table as soon as we arrived for our reservation. 


Our server appeared shortly after & took our drink order and provided some info about the menu. She took our food order and checked on us periodically while we waited. She was a great and attentive server and we never even had to ask for refills. 

Our food was brought out within a very reasonable amount of time. Plated beautifully and prepared perfectly. My husband had the fillet mignon and I had the halibut. We shared the grilled asparagus, roasted mushrooms & Yukon mashed potatoes. I was actually so full I had to take majority of the asparagus to go. I did however manage to share the warm chocolate lava cake w my hubby. It was served w a delicious scoop of caramel ice cream w a light salt layer underneath. 

I must admit, I enjoyed myself far more than I thought I would. Tye food was delicious, service wonderful and the experience was worth the extra money.
reviews.author: Melissa D.

reviews.text:
THIS is what fine dining is about. Every little detail is taken into consideration. Excellent service, especially under the leadership of Manager Brad Knox. He checked up on us and you can tell all the staff are in sync and are well trained and properly supervised by their manager/s. We enjoyed French Onion Soup, Iceberg Wedge, Peekytoe Crabcake (ultra fresh taste, good portion, and not filled with fillers that you don't taste actual crab like in most restaurants), Truffle fries was yummy, and the Creamed Spinach was also delicious. 
Nice ambience, high-end vibe and pricing, good food but biggest selling point is the service! Food is timed properly. Cutlery is provided for each course and you're not made to keep your used cutlery for the next food served like in most restaurants. Water is replenished and table checked at appropriate times. Not too frequent or intrusive but not too long of gaps either that you have to call a server's attention. Dedicated persons for linens/waters, taking your order (server), food runner, and other functions.
reviews.author: B S.

reviews.text: We had a large party and a dedicated server who was incredibly thoughtful and interactive with the group. The ambiance is great and the view from the restaurant is beautiful. There is a variety of appetizer and raw bar options. I would highly recommend!
reviews.author: Karen L.

reviews.text: Had a fantastic dinner here while staying at the resort. The view was great, the wait staff were nice and attentive, and the food quality was top notch. We started with some cocktails which were unique and flavorful. Then, we had the tasting menu experience and really enjoyed it. The black truffle cheese fritters were a great starter, the truffle brought a fantastic flavor to the fritters. Most of the time I'm not a fan of truffles because it just seems like a gimmick, but it was delicious in this dish. The tuna tartar was creamy and delicious and the acidic flavors highlighted the dish. The risotto was good, but could have used more pizzaz. The star of the show of course, was the filet mignon and lobster. Both were cooked to perfection, and honestly I really enjoyed the dipping sauces that came with the steak. I'm usually a no sauce guy when it comes to steak, but I enjoyed them. Finally, the dessert. It was honestly the only disappointing part of the meal. It really felt like an afterthought, it was just a lava cake with some ice cream. Nothing exciting about it at all, which seemed out of touch with the rest of the experience.
reviews.author: Noah S.

reviews.text:
Very nice view of the resort with the surrounding mountains. Great service. Food is okay compare to other places I've been to . 
Great for a romantic date night
reviews.author: Helen N.

reviews.text:
A few weeks ago,  I booked a reservation for my wife's birthday. We arrived at our appointment time, and the hostess looked up our reservation, turned to my wife, and said, "happy birthday!" We knew we were in for a wonderful experience. 

The manager quickly seated us with a nice view, introduced himself, wished my wife a wonderful birthday greeting, and then introduced "Jeff," our first waiter. From then on, each server wished my wife birthday greetings, and both our servers, Jeff and Austin, made sure our dinner experience was memorable. Jeff gave excellent menu recommendations, followed by the manager asking if we wanted him to take a few pictures, with the looming sunset and views behind us. We said, "yes!"

The food was amazing. My wife had the filet mignon, I had the sea bass, and we shared the lobster/macaroni shells. Delicious!

Our evening concluded with Austin gifting us with a nice birthday dessert for my wife.

The price was consistent with what you'd expect for upscale dining, but it was the service that made our dining experience memorable, and worth recommending to others. 

To the manager and staff who served us, thank you!
reviews.author: Simon  E.

reviews.text: Dinner is amazing! Great service and amazing view! Definitely recommend coming here for dinner!
reviews.author: Bren T.

reviews.text: Wow, just wow. One of our favorite treats is to come to J & G knowing we are going to always have an amazing meal. The food has never failed to deliver. The restaurant is at the top of the Phoenician Hotel and the view is spectacular. Service is top notch as well. Steaks and seafood always cooked to perfection. I mean, literally everything on the menu is delicious. We always order several different things as a family and share all around. If you like a nice fine dining meal with an amazing view of the valley, this is your new go to restaurant. If not, that leaves more availability for us to keep going back!
reviews.author: Michael S.

reviews.text: Stayed there over SB weekend, and was looking forward to a great meal, sadly all I got was great service....the steak was grocery store quality at best and way overpriced....the scallops were decent, crab cake ok......didn't expect Longhorn quality at all place with a chefs picture on the menu....
reviews.author: Dean C.

reviews.text:
Very nice steakhouse, with an incredible and vast view of the city and mountains. 

Our large party got a variety of dishes and meat. Everyone enjoyed theirs and cleaned their plates. Seems like the steaks were all a big hit. 

As a vegetarian, I come for the sides. I love steakhouse sides. The sides here were fine but not stellar. But the risotto was delicious! 

My chocolate lava cake was also very good but pretty small. 

Definitely worth a visit and I bet the views at sunset are to die for.
reviews.author: Emma T.

reviews.text: Fantastic dining event. My son and I split the tomahawk and it was definitely worth it. The rest of our party chose different options and everyone was extremely happy with the food. Drinks were also top notch. Only thing that matched the food was the service!
reviews.author: Justin A.

reviews.text: My friend and I stopped by the J & G steakhouse at the Phoenician resort tonight. We enjoyed an excellent meal! We had ribeye and pepper encrusted New York strip. Both were excellent! We also had delicious crispy fried calamari, and sides of brussels sprouts and asparagus. We finished with a good carrot cake. The service is great. The environment was restful. We had a really nice time.
reviews.author: Charles L.

reviews.text: I am so sad to leave this review because our waiter was AMAZING! The ambiance and vibe were great!! However the food was very mid! I would expect more from a restaurant at the Phoenician! My husband ordered the Bison and he wanted the Oscar style well they forgot to add it so they brought out a plate of some weird looking meat the kinda looked like tuna and it had chunks of okra or celery in it I have no idea what it was but it was GROSS!! I had the Short rib which was tender but the sauce was very sweet and it took away from the overall dish. The drinks were good and the dessert was amazing! The dessert was the only thing that was good honestly! I've been wanting to try this restaurant for quite a while and I'm not impressed at all. Again the service was amazing but the food no thanks! The food downstairs in the bar was by far better than this!
reviews.author: April  Reaves

reviews.text: Fabulous dinner on NYE. Food, ambiance and service were superb. We are staying at hotel and all of the restaurants have been so good with great service.
reviews.author: Lindsay G.

reviews.text: It began with the service- or lack of. Among having a literal sour face from the taste of the food, the hurried impersonal waitress asked how it was and ran away before a response. To start with old and cold bread, then presented with the French onion soup which was simply onion water. There was absolutely no base, or taste; "undercooked" we assumed. A log of steak for the steak frites, underwhelming. The over salted chicken Parmesan, tasting like a kid-made thanksgiving approach. The "creamed spinach" having the absolute worst aftertaste to an entire table of 4 that couldn't eat it at all- while still ignored by the waitress despite aiming to get her attention many times. Left with a $333 bill (pre tip) and unsatisfactory guests on food and service. Quite a "bombed" dinner on all levels, and it was a birthday celebration as well.
reviews.author: Lexi L.

reviews.text:
One of the best steakhouses I've ever been to. We came at 5pm with plenty of time to take in the golden hour and sunset. Stunning! We even saw a proposal! The ambiance and views are out of this world beautiful. The classy Christmas decorations were gorgeous and cozy also. 

Service is professional and friendly, 10/10 across the team especially our main server lady & the charming man at the host counter. 

Food was incredible. I haven't had a steak this good at a restaurant in a long time. There was a thin, crispiness on the outside of my filet but juicy and super tender inside. Perfectly seasoned. A trio of sauces accompanied our steaks: peppercorn, hollandaise & miso butter. The hollandaise was so good. It was lemony, decadent, whipped and airy. Highly recommend with the steaks, holy cow. 

My husband got a bone-in filet, which we both thought was a pleasantly rare thing to see on a menu. We rounded out or meal with the black truffle fritters, a split Caesar salad and the cheesy shells with lobster. We also enjoyed a couple glasses of Caymus Cabernet Blend, one of our favorite wines. 

There was so much more on the menu besides steak that I'd love to try next time. However, we saw a neighboring table got the Tomahawk for Two, and it looked like a bucket list experience! Loved this dinner so much and will be thinking about it all week.
reviews.author: Alana C.

reviews.text:
Reservations made on-line Dr not compute with restaurant.  6:15pm, 4 people.  Who knows what happened.  They were able to put a 4-top together in the bar.
The server/bartender was personable and no complaints.  Ambiance was ok.  The food not so much.  Soups and steaks were luke-warm.  No sizzle to the supposedly very hot plates.  The rare steaks were overcooked.  The medium steak was spot on.  Again, none of them were hot though.
Expensive.  My husband who is something of a steak expert says "never again."
reviews.author: Kathryn A.

reviews.text:
Food was great, Tuna tartare for appetizer was delicious! Bison for entree was flavorful and tender!
Michael and his assistant, Rosa, made it extra special with being helpful and attentive with a warm personality!
The atmosphere was extraordinary with the view of Phoenix and the inside open and spacious!
We would highly recommend J & G Steakhouse for fine dining!
reviews.author: Brenda R.

reviews.text: I had an excellent dining experience at this restaurant which is located at the Phoenician Hotel. The service was excellent and the views were great overlooking the valley. I had the filet which was cooked to perfection and the wedge salad and sautéed mushrooms were excellent too. They have an excellent beverage and wine selection too. I would highly recommend this place.
reviews.author: Jim S.

reviews.text: Beautiful ambiance and view here! Service was great. Wine list was perfect. Unfortunately, I felt the food fell short. The calamari was almost inedible (dry and unseasoned), the slow cooked salmon was nearly too salty to eat, and the Brussels sprouts were undercooked. Come for a drink and a beautiful view!
reviews.author: Courtney B.

reviews.text:
We walked in around 6 PM on a Friday night and there was no availability except for the seats at the bar and lounge area which, in my opinion, were actually stellar seats because they were up against the windows with a gorgeous view of the sunset over the city. Not upset about it at all! 

Daniel really made the experience at JNG steakhouse. I had several dietary requests and Daniel was totally chill about accommodating all of them. We ordered the grass fed boneless ribeye, a ton of veggies, and the Kabocha squash soup, which was my favorite! I loved the coconut cream and toasted coconut flakes on top and am now inspired to try a recipe like this at home. The espresso martini has also made it into my top three in the city - thx Gabe! They use a vanilla infused vodka, which really adds a unique flavor.

Overall, a lovely impromptu dining experience after a day at the spa.
reviews.author: Emily S.

reviews.text: Come for sunset!  We love coming here for the amazing view at sunset.  We order drinks from the bar and walk to the outdoor patio that overlooks The Phoenician Resort and surrounding area.  You can see Papago, downtown Phoenix, Tempe, Old Town Scottsdale, etc.  The food is excellent.  We haven't ordered anything that we didn't enjoy.  We usually order something from the raw bar, tuna tartar, black truffle cheese fritters, and split a salad and steak.  They are always so accommodating and have the kitchen split it for us.  The atmosphere is friendly and you really can't beat the view.
reviews.author: Jane H.

reviews.text:
Service and Ambience: What an amazing place.  We sat at the bar/ lounge area and had the greatest time and full dinner.  Everyone was so friendly.  We felt relaxed and welcomed.  The two bartenders were so friendly.  It was so good that we returned the next day.   We wanted to share some items and they were nice enough to bring us two plates instead. 
Food:   Some highlights were the tomato salad amazing , lots of flavor; Filet mignon tender and melted in my mouth; Salmon was so deliciously prepared. French onion soup was flavorful.   If you are ever in Scottsdale and staying at Phoenician you must try.
reviews.author: M A.

reviews.text:
I came with a group of friends to celebrate a birthday.

The restaurant is very classy with beautiful views of the resort and mountains from the patio. 

We were greeted with a smile by the restaurant host, Tom.  Tom was very nice and sat us immediately. 

Our sever, Chris, was simply outstanding.  We were never left waiting for service.  Chris  was very knowledgeable, made great suggestions from the menu and a kind and pleasant person. 

Two of us ordered filets which were cooked perfectly medium.  The other two in our party ordered the salmon which they said was cooked spot on. 

The sides we ordered included scalloped potatoes and creamed spinach.  Both were tasty and not overly heavy.

For desert, Chris brought the green apple cobbler!  Yummy! 

We thought the dinner was delicious and the restaurant was the perfect atmosphere for a special birthday dinner. 

We will definitely be back.
reviews.author: Holly M.

reviews.text: Atmosphere is great.....Service was outstanding! Don't be in a hurry, take in the dining experience. Steaks were great. Listen to your server when recommending side sauces. Manager was great with his wine recommendations and table side visits to chat about wine.
reviews.author: Tim M.

reviews.text: J & G Steakhouse, a dinner delight, filet mignon cooked to sheer perfection at night. The chopped salad so good, we had to conspire, to crack the recipe we deeply admire. Cocktails in hand and wine pours so grand, with Phoenix lights flickering, its view is quite grand.
reviews.author: Rhyme And D.

reviews.text: I had reservations at the bar.  The servers behind the bar Daniel and Gabe were great to chat with. I ordered 7oz grass fed steak with broccoli and mushrooms, dinner was very good. The view had a great sunset and the ambiance fit well with the view.  My evening was enjoyable I went back another night for a cocktail before I went out
reviews.author: Maryanne S.

reviews.text: My husband and I had the pleasure of dining here for an anniversary. The staff is courteous and polite. The steakhouse itself was pristine. Even better is the scenic view right outside the patio. We had made reservations in the evening just after the sun had set. We decided to step outside while we waited on our food. Even though it was nighttime, we were still able to enjoy the view of the moonlight. Outside were multiple fire pits, surrounded by happy families and couples nestled together. Back inside we received the first part of our course, a seasonal item I don't quite remember the name, a pork-based dish with an orange glaze. We found that dish to be delectable. We ordered a steak that was made to our desire. One of the side dishes, the J&G Lobster Shells & Cheese, was our favorite. Chunks of lobster, giant pasta shells, and gooey pulls of cheese- it was an elevated take on mac and cheese they executed marvelously. Dessert was on the house, a sweet touch by the staff that was aware we were celebrating a special occasion. After our meal, we made our way to the the resort lobby. There, we found comfortable seats to lounge on as we waited for our ride. The bar downstairs was overflowing with guests. A band played music while a small group of patrons danced. Everyone was having a great time. A staff member asked what we were celebrating and when we said our anniversary. We were then offered complimentary drinks. Another gesture we greatly appreciated. It's fair to say we had an excellent visit.
reviews.author: Genesis S.

reviews.text: So, where to start. Table of one. I get it. Probably only $200 check but let's go with less people to impress. Very underwhelmed with the waiter, Jose's attention to anyone near me who was a swindle. When I mentioned the seat was so over air conditioned that I had to decline dessert or move l was put me at a used table (not that theee were any other seatings at 9pm).  Just Not what I expected out of a restaurant within the Phoenician.
reviews.author: Nicole R.

reviews.text: Fabulous, staff and manager Frank come to your table to make sure everything is top notch . Spectacular view and great food.
reviews.author: Jeff L.

reviews.text: The service is amazing. Mike the manager made sure we were fully taken care of on our anniversary, checked in multiple times and even gave us a dessert on the house. Our server Isaac was also very attentive and kind. Everyone was very friendly and welcoming. The food was tasty, prepared right (I got a medium rare steak and it was prepared as such). Mike even asked to take pictures of us on the balcony for our anniversary, which is now a memory we will share. I cannot recommend this place enough!
reviews.author: Paige H.

reviews.text: Amazing views and service was great! Located in the Phoenician. It's a must try if you're visiting Phoenix on vacation.
reviews.author: Jennifer S.

reviews.text: Beautiful restaurant! The ambience and views of the mountains on the balcony were outstanding. I took my fiancé on a date just because and he loved it as well. Our waiter was fantastic and provided really great suggestions such as the heirloom & cucumber salad, my fiancé tried the lamb chops and creamed spinach which he was completely awe by and I ordered the calamari and peppercorn steak which was cooked to perfection. The sauce was great as well. Our waiter also suggested mocktails since I am pregnant. I really appreciate that he had an eye for detail. I loved that part. He also brought out a beautiful dessert to congratulate us on our new baby. The restaurant was fairly priced as well as I expected to spend more. We will be back!
reviews.author: Amber S.

reviews.text:
Well staying at the Phoenician so far has been a 1/10 with delayed check in and ina polity to access wireless. Not good
So as a glutton for punishment I made a reservation here
For a restaurant that is large and has much empty tables you think you were dining ina. Five star restaurant for limited availability 
Absurd really
Starting with the waitress who obviously could not remember simple side dishes ordered like spinach and french fries
Wow must be a brain teaser
Well i ordered the famous black truffle fried and sauteed spinach for anemia filet mignon and my wife the slow cooked salmon with rhubarb glaze
The restaurant is surrounded by sites of lights in Scottsdale and was breathtaking
Loud restaurant but could hear my wife during dinner
The filet bone in was one of the best prepared I have eaten salted perfectly with an almost umami flavor
The truffle fries were perfect served with black truffle ketchup and a garlic aioli
The salmon wa cooked perfectly and completed
Sauteed spinach was flavored with a sense of dill sauteed well
Overall wonderful dinner balancing a
Tough start
Thank you
reviews.author: Andrew M.

reviews.text: J&G Steakhouse was truly delicious! We started off with house made bread that just melted in your mouth it was beyond soft and buttery! Then we ordered black truffle cheese fritters, and shared a 16oz six peppercorn prime NY steak, and then we were given warm chocolate cake on the house for our honeymoon  they were so kind and attended to us very well! Definitely will be coming back here! The vibe is so romantic and we were on the highest floor and the balcony view was incredible!
reviews.author: Iris P.

reviews.text:
Let me begin this review by stating the obvious: this restaurant is in a nice hotel with amazing views. Aside from that and the wine selection, I have minimal good things to say. 

My husband and I went to this restaurant as his surprise for me on my birthday. They were nice enough to greet me happy birthday when we got there but the experience was like a gift that I wanted to return. 

Our server was nice but I felt like we were being hurried through the evening. Not much input on the menu but he did, to good credit, have a good knowledge of the wines they have available. 

The waitress that was serving our food and the other who refilled our drinks looked like it was their first time doing it. One kept either over pouring the water or dropping ice everywhere. Simple mistakes are fine but she just walks away like it never happened. We had to ask someone else to help us wipe down the table. 

The one who was serving the food was just trying to shove everything on the table with no effort to make space. We had to move plates and food and drinks (which spilled) around ourselves.

I didn't expect that kind of service for a place such as J&G steakhouse. My husband was so disappointed since it was his surprise for me.

The food was sub par. I ordered a medium rare steak and it arrived as well done on the outside (very dry) and raw on the inside. And it arrived cold. The truffle fries were well seasoned but they looked like they came out of a Costco bag. And the lobster Mac and cheese was mostly pasta shells and some lobster. 

All in all, it was a sub par experience. We didn't let it ruin our night but maybe J&G steakhouse is now way past its prime. 

All in all,
reviews.author: Kim G.

reviews.text: The service is the main reason im giving this restaurant 5 stars. Everyone was Extremely attentive and the manager even went around to introduce himself. The view is beautiful day time or night. The food was yummy especially the steak. This venue is so fancy and it has a bar. Perfect for an anniversary.
reviews.author: Andrea P.

reviews.text:
Let me start by saying the staff are very very nice. Service staff was not an issue. We went there for anniversary and they made us feel special.

Now the problem was the food. It was average for the price and it took longer than usual to get to us. Earlier in the day, My husband and I split lunch and everything all day and had our own steaks at JG. He ended up with food poisoning so we both believe it was from his dinner. So done at your own risk. It was not worth $400.
reviews.author: kevin M.

reviews.text:
During the B2B Marketing Exchange I had dinner here and it was great. First and foremost the views are insane and gorgeous, the service was  immaculate! 

I definitely cannot wait to come back
reviews.author: MoShai G.

reviews.text: Gorgeous view from the steakhouse at the Phoenician. The patio is fantastic. I had the crabcake appetizer, which was amazing. Then I had a fillet, which was just average. Service was excellent.
reviews.author: Michele S.

reviews.text:
Treated very well!

I had planned on dining in-restaurant but was unable to because my wife was feeling tired and instead had to do take-out.  I was staying at the Phoenician, too.

The host or GM, could have been either, went out of his way to take care of me, ring me up at the bar for the food I wanted and even brought me some water while I hung out.

He really didn't need to do any of that on such a busy Saturday night.

Thanks so much J&G!
reviews.author: Joseph B.

reviews.text:
I was really looking forward to this place, but a few things spoiled it. You will probably have a better experience than I did so still give it a shot.

The negatives were we got sat at a tiny table even though everyone around us were parties of 2 at 4 tops. We asked for a bigger table but they couldn't make it work.

Our server never mentioned it was our anniversary, although he did to the table next to us. I ordered my steak medium rare but it came blue rare, though he did fix it quickly.

And lastly the food took a while to come out.

Overall the staff was very friendly and made us feel welcome.
reviews.author: Garrett J.

reviews.text:
Heard about this place from friends and acquaintances, but never tried. Decided to come couple days before Christmas holidays to soak up festive atmosphere and try some delicious food.
Huge applause goes to our waitress Jiovanna who was very much on top of her game, provided us with fabulous recommendations and constantly kept checking up on us to make sure we had everything we needed. She recommended seabass dish that was phenomenal. I have eaten the fish all over the world-from Moscow to Amsterdam but never tried such delicious seabass. Her recommendation was spot on! Lobster Mac&Cheese was fabulous as well.
My husband likes his steak, however that was a disappointment. It's wasn't cooked to his satisfaction, and waitress comped us a dessert to make up for that.
Overall, if you're not going to this steakhouse to try a good steak and open to other delicious dishes, that's the place for you. Service is superb and ambience is beautiful. Jiovanna was the best!
reviews.author: Gina S.

reviews.text:
My wife and I went to J&G for Christmas dinner. The Phoenician resort is amazing. The entrance spectacular, the restaurant staff is fantastic. From the dinner perspective our meal was great, seafood platter, sea bass, and filet garnished with mushrooms and lobster Mac and cheese. The two waiters who took care of us were on top of it!!! 

Chris was our main waiter and he was great!!!

We have been here before and will be back soon!!

Thank You,
Bob
reviews.author: Bob W.

reviews.text:
Stay away. Unfriendly service, no desire to help their guests. I was staying at hotel in a suite, I am Marriott Ambassador Elite and even though the restaurant had many open tables they would not accommodate a request for early seating. Wasn't allowed to sit at the empty tables and chairs in the bar room and was told we could only sit at the bar. Bartender was unfriendly. Maitre'd was unfriendly, wait staff wouldn't look us in the eye. 

After waiting an hour looking at an empty restaurant we left and went to a restaurant with great service even though they were three times as busy.

The restaurant looks old, the decor totally uninspiring, and no service ethic.  Didn't stick around long enough to try the food as we went to one of the many amazing Phoenix restaurants that actually wanted our business. 

Never going back here.
reviews.author: Ted R.

reviews.text:
J&G was our favorite steakhouse of the 3 that we tried during our Scottsdale visit. The view, food and service were fabulous. This is a great place for a romantic dinner, anniversary or date night! 

We came here twice during the week we stayed at the hotel. The first visit we ordered salmon, filet and the mushroom side. They were so kind to have a handwritten note for my husband's birthday and a delicious complimentary dessert. The complimentary bread is so good! For the 2nd visit, we did the tasting menu which all 3 of us liked very much. Everyone does have to order this if you choose this option but it was a nice way to try a variety of items. Since the tasting menu has the same items you can order, if you have a bigger group or not everyone wants to do the tasting menu, you can just order the appetizers to share as well. It was nice to try the tasting menu but not sure I would get that again unless there were items on the tasting menu that you couldn't get otherwise.
reviews.author: Quan D.

reviews.text:
Thanksgiving plans? Don't bother!  They were obnoxious and pretty much acted as if they didn't want your business. They don't answer the phone or return calls. And when you speak with them, the hostess is rude on the phone. 

It's one thing to be busy but still gracious! The manager needs to truly spend time and train the staff o. Basic etiquette. Learn from the people who manage Steak44! They know what service is about
reviews.author: Jeff P.

reviews.text: Reserved a private dining room here for an intimate wedding celebration/reception.  Absolute horrendous communication with the coordinator Antonia from the get go in March. She never answered phone calls I spoke to her two times over the phone. Once initially to book and the second only to apologize for not responding. Honestly it was impossible to reach her I would send her an email and kept getting automatic replies and she would not respond for days and kept apologizing for the delay in her response. I got fed up in October when I tried to reach out and just ended up calling the restaurant to complain that it is unacceptable. Also on the actual day Antonia's notes said it was a rehearsal dinner... no it was a wedding celebration which I told her in the beginning. Embarrassing... Also they only gave us two servers and one servers assistant. Really? For a party of 40? We needed one more server at least we had four tables of ten. Also I overheard Laurie (server) complaining/talking crap about us to the SA. Super unprofessional. Servers looked flustered/annoyed. Food was okay. The bread served beforehand was so dry. I used to work private dining at seasons 52 and El Chorro. Please just go there instead for your group.  Way better service (4 or 5 servers for party of 40) and better food at a better price point
reviews.author: Hannah S.

reviews.text: We always have a good experience here. Food and service are excellent. I recommend the sticky toffee pudding for dessert.
reviews.author: J Z.

reviews.text:
What started as a wonderful experience with our family celebrating our grandson's 16th birthday devolved into a disappointing evening. Initially the service was as expected for an upscale steak house but it quickly declined. While eating our appetizers, including a seafood platter, we encountered an unopened mussel, which never should have made it past inspection in the kitchen. When it was pointed out to staff, it was taken to the bar for inspection and subsequently to a manager. A while later, a single mussel in a dish was brought to the table without a word being said. One grandson ordered a ribeye and requested it blue; it came medium. Another ordered the tomahawk which he normally devours but this one lacked any seasoning. The sea bass and the lobster, as well as the brussel sprouts were undercooked and under seasoned. We experienced long delays between courses and were unable to even get our water glasses refilled. 

Our family has enjoyed dining at many of the finest restaurants in the Phoenix area over the years and this was decidedly not one of them.
reviews.author: Steve F.

reviews.text: The best.    The service was top notch.    The view was incredible.   And the tasting menu was unbelievable.   Oh.....the French Onion Soup was the best that I've ever had.    Thank you for a great experience for my fiancée's birthday.
reviews.author: Steve G.

reviews.text:
I had an amazing time at J&G steakhouse. Service was EXCELLENT, the ambiance EXCELLENT, the most important...food was EXCELLENT. J&G Steakhouse is located at the Phoenician Resort. The food that was ordered; the crispy calamari, grass fed boneless ribeye steak, macaroni and cheese, and the Lamb T-Bone.
The calamari was so delicious and full of flavor. The seasoning on this was superb and the rosemary dipping sauce complimented it so well, the grass fed ribeye came with broccoli condiment, crispy garlic, ginger and chili....this was so delicious, steak was cooked perfect, broccoli very good and the crispy garlic, ginger and chili concoction gave a nice kick to the steak. (chef's kiss). Lastly, the mac and cheese and Lamb T-Bone was oh so very good. The restaurant has a really view of the grounds of the resort and some of Phoenix. Everything was just beautiful. 

Rate J&G Steakhouse 10/10
reviews.author: Elaine R.

reviews.text:
Our server was so kind and welcoming, the views are lovely, but the food just ok. 

Bread to start is ok. The tomato salad looks beautiful, but needed salt. Caesar salad is very heavily dressed and a bit pale looking with croutons that didn't add anything special. King crab tasted fine, but quite pricey. Lobster mac is very rich- more of a cream sauce than cheese, with big chunks of perfectly cooked lobster. A nice splurge if you have a group to share bc a few bites is enough. The sauteed spinach had a strong spice/herb that I wasn't expecting and didn't love. The staff is friendly, but service was a bit uncoordinated. Dishes were delivered without serving utensils. Plates and utensils cleared after the first course, but not replaced. 

Fine place to go if you want to get dressed up and sit somewhere pretty. Maybe stick to the bar for a glass of sparkling wine next time.
reviews.author: Ryen B.

reviews.text:
During my staycation at The Phoenician, I dined at J & G Steakhouse. This was a very pleasant dining experience. The atmosphere was upscale and the outside views are amazing. 

The food looked appetizing and tasted very good. The service was fantastic. My sister who I was with got escorted to the restroom instead of being pointed in its direction.

I ordered the calamari for an appetizer. It was very fresh amd cooked perfectly with a light flaky batter. For my entree I ordered the lamb T-bone and a side of mac n cheese. Both were very delicious.

The one thing that I will need to return for is the dessert.
reviews.author: Jaquay R.

reviews.text: Carli and Jeff were spectacular, great service, great smiles, lots of jokes. The food was impeccable can't say enough about it, definitely will be back
reviews.author: David O.

reviews.text: We dined here as a family on a quick layover back from from Cabo. I googled restaurants and liked the menu and reviews about the view so we decided to try it. They did NOT disappoint! The service was amazing. Even though it was closer to when they closed the service was impeccable as if it was busy. Becky our waitress was amazing and recommended great suggestions for our meals and appetizers. She even had a hand written card to tell my husband happy birthday which was so thoughtful. Our food runner Quentin took the time to introduce himself and let us know he would be serving us for the evening. And our other food runner Nathan was so quick with clearing our table and prepping us for the next portion of our meal. I had to compliment the manager Frank Armanetti in person for his staff and the food being a great way to end our family vacation and my husband's birthday before we traveled back home. Thank you for a great experience. 10/10 would highly recommend.
reviews.author: Jasmine B.

reviews.text: Nice Experience. The restaurant is nice. It is a great for a special date night or celebration. However, it is expensive. The food was good but still felt overpriced to me. Expect to spend at least $100 per person, easy. Overall, enjoyed the dinner, the service and atmosphere.
reviews.author: Tony R.

reviews.text:
One of the best steaks that I have had in the desert. Visiting town from Los Angeles for the weekend so we wanted a special place to have a great dinner. I have stayed at the Phoenician a few times before so have known about J&G for quite a while but last night was our first time trying it. It has great views of the valley and is very large and open on the inside. They have a large and long bar with live music on one side and then a lot of seating options next to that. We reserved a booth by the window however there was a booking issue so we had to sit at another table. Our server was very polite and prompt, and made up for the seating mishap a bit. 

I chose the Heirloom Tomatoes with Roasted Peaches, and the Filet Mignon 12oz.  The heirloom tomatoes were very tasty although the dish was very small in portion size. I wouldn't really call it an appetizer, it is more a starter or tapas sized portion. The steak, however, was delicious and cooked perfectly. Definitely one of the better steaks that I've had in the desert and I would certainly order it again.

Overall a really great dinner with great service and a great steak. The only issue we had was the seating mishap, but aside from that it was a great dinner overall and I would definitely recommend it.
reviews.author: Zan L.

reviews.text: Came here for my fiance b day. Food was okay wasnt that great for the price and service wasn't all that great. Requested to get a seatting view and it wasn't what I expected, wasnt a good view where i was seated. I didn't think the bread was good it was on warm side and didnt look fresh and good. Overall it was an okay experience, they could of gave me a good view instead of just lookin outside just a light versus i requested to see sunset.
reviews.author: Lyn P.

reviews.text: Food is incredible, the truffle fritters were insane. The waiter was very knowledgeable and frequent. Great experience and a great view!
reviews.author: Adison H.

reviews.text:
I've been here a few times.  Surprised I've never written a review.  Food is always good to great, depending what you get.  However, the service is always very good here.  Plus, great views of the property.  Last time I came, they had a live musician so that was kinda cool.  I caught the tail end of that.  

When I arrived, I had to wait for my table as I was a little early.  I sat in the bar area, and noticed nothing had been cleaned so there were dirty/empty glasses at all the tables and no one was sitting there.  Not sure if they were short staffed or cuz it was toward the end of the night, they figured no one would come up and didn't bother to clean?  It was a bit odd and seemed very unlike them.

Was shown to a table and it's just funny that they sit me in the same table as last time I was there.  Is that the only option for single or two top?  Hmmm.  Cuz it's always inbetween two big tables and they are usually quite loud so I don't like that, but whatever.  I had an awesome server.  I think his name was Wes?  He was so thorough and kind and attentive.  He told me the specials.  He checked in on me while he was busy serving multiple tables.  He let me order extra scoops of sorbet and when he realized the kitchen didn't bring me one of the flavors, he personally went to the back to get it for me.  He was super prompt in bagging up my leftovers and taking care of the check.  I don't like holding up people after the restaurant is closed so I was in and out in under an hour.  I don't think they are used to that, but he rolled with it like a professional.  I enjoyed my steak, fries, the bernaise sauce, and my coconut ice cream and berry sorbet.  The French onion soup was meh--I had wanted the corn soup, but they were out.  Would definitely come back whenever I'm at the hotel or near the area.  The table next to me actually asked to speak to the manager to tell them how good the food and service was and I thought that was really sweet of them.  The other table left to go take pix outside and I think their server took the pix for them.
reviews.author: Christina B.

reviews.text:
Expensive but the food was excellent as was the service.
Get the tomahawk to share with others, they cut it at your table.
reviews.author: Brad D.

reviews.text: Very attentive staff. Explaining everything about the sauces that are the stand out items of this restaurants. We loved the shrimp starters, the main course with side of asparagus and the chocolate cake dessert!!!
reviews.author: Vaishali D.

reviews.text: Came here for a work dinner and it was an awesome experience. We received a nice table away from the hustle and bustle so we could easily make conversation. The service was friendly and attentive without being overbearing. Lastly, the food was great. My filet was cooked to a perfect medium rare and seasoned expertly. Sides and deserts were great too. Definitely worth checking out!
reviews.author: David H.

reviews.text: Suzan & Abigail took great care of us and provided an amazing experience on our anniversary. Both exude professionalism and experience with just the right amount of personality and charm. Their service was truly impeccable and completely seamless. I'd take a drink of water, and they'd be there within seconds with a refill--not just once, but all night. We had the truffle cheeese fritters and onion soup (equally divine), Angel hair pasta, New York steak and side of mushrooms, and the everything we tasted was euphorically delicious. Pair that with the ambience and you've got the perfect fine-dining experience. Thank you J&G.
reviews.author: Mick M.

reviews.text: Make sure your reservation is made during sunset! The view here is amazing! My fav dish has to be the parm crusted chicken! The service is always great here!
reviews.author: Stephanie H.

reviews.text:
J&G Steakhouse is located inside The Phoenician, Scottsdale's luxury resort hotel. When you pull at the front of the hotel, you already feel like you're on a vacation getaway.  Walk through the open, airy lobby and take the elevator directly to J&G.

As soon as you step off, you'll notice a round table with a beautiful floral arrangement and as you walk around you are able to see the dinner menu offerings propped on the table as well as drinks and cocktails menus on the other side of the table.  Then you will notice the hostess stand at the end of room that opens to a grand bar and lounge with a spectacular view of the resort and the city of Phoenix.

While the patrons' attire ranged from neat, resort casual to formal and dressy, this restaurant is definitely a place where you can enjoy from having an intimate dinner to having a large party celebrating a special occasion.  

The staff and service here are incredible, attentive and amazing.  They were great to engage with and extremely helpful with the menu selections.  From start to finish, one of the best fine dining experience I've had in a long while.

Each dish that was ordered was prepared and plated beautifully.  We couldn't help but be awed by everyone's selections.  The taste was perfection.  

Thank you so much for a wonderful and memorable night!
reviews.author: Cyndi K.

reviews.text: Our son is getting married in Scottsdale and we are looking for a nice restaurant to have the rehearsal dinner. J&G came highly recommended for their food and atmosphere. We were not disappointed! The wait staff was AWESOME and very attentive. The views from the dining room are fantastic and the food was delicious! I had the grass fed ribeye and my wife got the scallops. Very nice experience. If your near Camelback Mountain and looking for a nice dining experience with great views, give J&G a try... you won't be disappointed!!!
reviews.author: Scott R.

reviews.text:
We were really excited to try this steakhouse on our stay at the Phoenician. My husband really enjoyed his dirty martinis with blue cheese olives! We started with the truffle fritters and those were definitely the star of the evening, so good!! And we had the French Onion soup, and that was unfortunately disappointing. The flavor was off. The server was really kind and apologized and took that off. 
They recently changed their menu so when I went to order the salmon, I noticed it was different from what I'd seen on yelp. This salmon had a carrot basil sauce. I decided to try it and it was ok. The salmon was perfectly cooked but I was not in love with the carrot sauce. However, they do have side sauces that were delicious. The two I loved were the Miso Mustard and a Peppered sauce. They were delicious mixed together with the salmon.
My husband ordered the peppered NY strip. It was seasoned well and cooked perfectly (mr) but for some reason it was tough and dry. It was very disappointing. 
Our experience was still really nice even though some of the food was not great because the service was exceptional. Michael was very accommodating and made the dinner fun. Thank you!
reviews.author: Jennifer K.

reviews.text: Food  and service was excellent . Beautiful view . Tomahawk oyster Mac and cheese. Staff was incredible bravo
reviews.author: Vana M.

reviews.text: The food and service was excellent. The manager Mike sat us and continually checked on us throughout the dinner. I have high standards working in a high net worth space, and the waiters exceeded expectations and so did management. We ordered shrimp cocktail which was phenomenal the jumbo shrimp with the 3 dipping sauces was some good the best shrimp we had had in AZ. We split a main lobster and 12 oz filet mignon wide a side of baked potato and asparagus. Everything was to the highest of standards!
reviews.author: Lindsey S.

reviews.text:
Last weekend my husband and I had the pleasure of visiting Scottsdale Arizona. We made our first dinner reservations at J G. Having eaten there previously, it was a must. We had made our reservation ~ 2 months in advance and requested a table outside. Upon arriving at the Phoenician, we started off by having drinks overlooking the pool which was delightful. We then proceeded upstairs to J&G. Within minutes we were incredibly disappointed, as the hostess informed us there was no room outside and changed us  to a table indoors which we found unacceptable. 
We asked to see the manager. Frank Armanetti introduced himself to us and escorted us to a table near the bar, while he figured out the situation. Several minutes later he asked us to be patient as he was trying desperately to accomodate us. Frank was amazing. He not only accommodated us by sitting us outside, but sat us in the most elegant and romantic spot imaginable. We can only say that he turned a disaster into one of the most enjoyable experiences ever. He was friendly, capable and hospitable. Every manager should follow in his footsteps. Kudos to Frank!
reviews.author: Marianne B.

reviews.text: Got to the restaurant  15 minutes  early , the views from the hotel are beautiful.  We were not allowed  to be seated  until  our entire party was there , one member was 15 minutes late so we ended up standing  for 30 minutes which was irrating.  They missed the opportunity to get us drinks no one came to check on us in the waiting area. The spacing in the restaurant  was good so we can have good conversation.  Our waiter was friendly  but did not helpful with the menu.  I ordered  the pea soup which tasted like hot water or like a package  mix. I had two spoons and left it the waiter never asked why I did not enjoy my soup, we ordered  calamari  appetizers, the portion was small  one piece  per person for 8 of us , there was a 20 minute  wait before  our appetizers  came , after  ordering  my meal it took 45 minutes  before our meal was served  , our meals did not come to our table at the same time  there was about  7 minutes before our party was all served,  I asked  for my steak to be low salt on a ribeye,  the steak was less fatty and dry, I ordered  baked potato  but they forgot  my condiments,  the shrimp  I ordered  was extremely  salty.  My waiter did ask why I only ate two ounces  of my steak  but I did not want to cause  a scene.  We ordered  dessert  since I was still  hungry.  I ordered  berries  just strawberries and blue berries  , but they brought  half black berries and raspberry which I mentioned  to the waiter, the scoop of ice cream  was so small . It took about 20 minutes  before the dessert  was served,  all together  it took 4 hours for dinner,  I planned  on 2 and half hours  but not 4 . The price was higher than the top end restaurants the meal was just average  at best at such a high end and respected  restaurant,  service was average  but a great  view
reviews.author: Anthony K.

reviews.text: The food was so expensive for the quality of steak. I enjoyed the staff and they helped make the birthday celebration nice. Of course the view is beautiful. Don't waste you money on dinner here.. get a drink and eat somewhere else. Very disappointing.
reviews.author: Kim B.

reviews.text: This restaurant is average at best.  We ordered the Wagyu Tomahawk for two, it was overcooked, I didn't feel like making a big deal out of it. The french fries were cooked in Soybean oil which is ridiculous, you would think a French chef would know that that is bad oil and it should be deep-fried in beef tallow or duck fat. I am sure in France they don't fry or cook in soy bean oil. We had Michael as a server he was terrific his partner was not quite as competent. For dessert we tried the warm chocolate and the sticky toffee pudding and they where not great.  KICKER. IF YOU USE AMEX GOLD CARD FOR 4X POINTS YOU WONT GET THEM BECAUSE THEY CHARGE YOUR CARD UNDER HOTELS ACCT.
reviews.author: Shawn L.

reviews.text: I wasn't too impressed. We were admittedly late to our reservation but attempted to call while we were on our way and there was no answer (I left a voicemail). When we got there they said we were past the grace period (like 4 mins) and when I mentioned I had called to let them know they said their phone wasn't working. They had us sit at a table in the lobby/bar area and the waitress was not pleasant at all. They said they couldn't give us an idea of how long the wait would be for a table. After waiting a while we started to order and then they moved us. The food was good. The service was better and friendlier in the dining area. Our main course took forever even though we ordered the prix fixed dinner option, so we took the dessert to go. We were there for our wedding anniversary. I just didn't love how we were treated.
reviews.author: Esther H.

reviews.text: Very nice restaurant. Beautiful view, great food, excellent service. Came to celebrate my birthday for a fancy date with my better half. We shared the wagyu - it was terrific.
reviews.author: Harold K.

reviews.text: Romantic date night? J&G has you covered.  The amazing panoramic view of the city personifies the language of Love. You will be surrounded by Family celebrations and smiles, full of enjoyment and love. We arrived on Saturday, to our surprise we were greeted by live music entertainment in the bar/lounge area. I have to say it did get a bit loud for our taste, but it was a welcomed surprise. We had a large party of 9 and they accommodated us in more ways than one. Service was amazing very attentive to our table. The food is gourmet, fresh and delicious. Wish I could have taken more pictures, it was so good didn't have time. It's the perfect backdrop for a perfect evening. Don't forget get your parking validated if you don't valet.
reviews.author: Edgar D.

reviews.text:
This is a perfect special occasion spot! The restaurant is gorgeous, the food is well prepared, and the service is 5-star. I'd recommend a reservation for this spot as meals here can take a while. From sitting down to paying the bill it was a total of 2.5 hours. For me that's an eternity, but in this case it was time well spent.

The restaurant is huge with one of the best views of Phoenix I've ever seen. All of the tables are positioned to admire the south facing view of Downtown Phoenix and Tempe. I was very impressed!

A lot of the food here is very generic to other steak houses but they tend to push the seafood here more than anything else. If seafood is your thing you gotta come here! I'm not that big of a fan of shellfish and wanted to try out a few of the different options on the menu. Fortunately they had a pre fixed menu option that came with:
Truffle potato fritters that were basically croquets,
Tuna tartare (a local favorite apparently),
Mushroom risotto,
Entree of 1/2 Lobster and a filet mignon,
Dessert of chocolate lava cake.
All for $99 so we decided to go for this option!

We decided to sub the filet mignon for an 8 oz cut of the prime New York strip. The staff was in a bit of an uproar, they'd never heard of someone wanting to sub out the filet. Eventually, as you can see from the pics they were able to accommodate. I'd definitely recommend it cause the New York Strip was amazing. It's always been my experience that Filet Mignon is pretty underwhelming. 

I'd do the pre fix menu again but it'd be nice to get a different dessert next time. Chocolate lava cake just reminds me of Jack in the Box drive thru.

If you need a spot to propose, to take out your parents, or to just feel special for a night, I'd recommend this J&G Steak house.
reviews.author: Joash O.

reviews.text:
Food was better than expected!

I was hesitant about getting the Tasting Menu but the food exceeded my expectations. We started the night off with some wine and cocktails and were pleasantly surprised by the complimentary bread. The bread was unique. It tasted like a Brioche bun but shaped like a muffin. The first course was the Black Truffle Cheese Fritters. Amazing! I could have had 10 more of them. The Mushroom Risotto came next. It was a cheesy perfection! I typically don't like risotto but this one was the best I've had. Afterward came there Tuna Tartare which I was a bit skeptical about. However, it was creamy and tasty. We swapped the Grilled Filet Mignon for the 10oz Six Peppercorn Prime NY Steak for an $8 up charge. That was delicious! The Main Lobster was nice! I wish it had a sauce to accompany it. The dessert was ok, definitely not my favorite. 

The food was 5 star but I felt that since we were a party of two, we were often overlooked by our server. We were surrounded by 4 tops and we sensed that our server was paying way more attention to the larger tables (more tips $).
reviews.author: Sarah B.

reviews.text: disappointing. The food was generally very good. We started out with a very good crab cake and shrimp cocktail appetizers. The salads that we had were excellent as well (heirloom tomato, chopped, and wedge). My dinner companions all enjoyed their filets. Mine came and as soon as I cut into it my waiter immediately noted that it was undercooked and took it away. It looked actually looked like it may have been a bad cut of meat, but I assumed the chef would notice that. The same piece of meat came back having been seared. The manager literally stood over me while I cut into again and asked in the most condescending way whether it was now "too my liking." I had ordered my steak medium rare and when I cut into the double cooked piece of meat again it was still quite bloody. I was completely taken aback when the manager then said "if you ask me, it looks medium rare" but if I wanted, I could send it back "again." I was literally speechless and told him it was fine. But it was not. I took a bite of the mushy mess that was now clear to me was a bad cut of meat and asked my waiter to please come take it away. Our whole table was shocked by the managers behavior. I let our kind, helpful and attentive waiter know what happened. He was apologetic and sent a second manager who was also apologetic and offered us desert and after dinner drinks. The original manager, who was so insulting, never bothered to come back and apologize. I hope the issues with this manager will get addressed. In the end, without a steak in my belly, the four of us had the pleasure of paying $500 for our meal.  Next time I am in need of a steak I will head to Durants.
reviews.author: Happy D.

reviews.text: We enjoyed a fantastic dinner at J&G Steakhouse. Our servers - Suzan and Scott - were professional, knowledgeable, and attentive.  Suzan worked closely with us to accommodate our food allergies (gluten and dairy) and had great suggestions for dining selections. I had an appetizer of briny and fresh British Columbia oysters that were fantastic. We were served toasted gluten-free bread and dairy-free cashew butter. Our meals were a prime ribeye and a prime porterhouse accompanied by a salt-crusted baked potato (with cashew butter and bacon) and brussel sprouts. A couple of mixed drinks and a glass of wine rounded out the meal. Simply outstanding. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Chris S.

reviews.text:
Stopped by for happy hour & it did not disappoint!

Crab legs on deck with plenty of hor dourves, along with some white wines & plenty of vino.

Service was pleasant, can't wait to sit down & dine in with an actual steak next time around.

Will have to check it out when I'm back in town & certainly recommend to a friend that I'll bring along!
reviews.author: Roger D.

reviews.text:
DO NOT EAT HERE!! How do you ruin a filet mignon? I don't know, but ask the cooks at J and G, they did. The second reason to NOT EAT HERE, is, they have a wonderful sounding "classic tasting menu" prix fix dinner but can be ordered only if the entire party orders it. 
I posted a picture of the "classic tasting menu" and at the bottom it states "entire table, please", a confusing disclaimer, we should've walked out when the waiter explained it to us. But the wait help noticed I had just a few bites from my 12 oz filet and offered us a complementary/consolation free dessert. 
You have been warned, DONOT EAT HERE!!!
reviews.author: Ross Y.

reviews.text: Such a great dining experience. For starters I sat at the bar. Abby was super good company. I did her recommendation of wine which went delicious with everything. The tuna tar tar was the best I've EVER had. It melts in your mouth like butter and the ginger is incredibly fresh in it. Not to mention it's a good size. Then had the lamb which was also very good it was cooked perfectly, I loved the chile sauce on the side the other was a little thick to my liking but still very delicious. Will be back
reviews.author: Courtney C.

reviews.text:
A steakhouse that caters to gluten-free and their menu is literally almost 100% gluten-free oh that I forgot to mention they have gluten-free bread!!!!!!!!!!
A lot of restaurants  and manly steakhouses do not cater to gluten-free they don't have gluten free, french fries, gluten free bread...
but coming here everything pretty much is a gluten-free and everything is amazing. The staff is so knowledgeable, the views of the city are breathtaking.
reviews.author: Katie M.

reviews.text: The good was bland. Not worth the price. The view was great. A good place for outdoor drinks.
reviews.author: Mimi M.

reviews.text:
This was my second time to this establishment. If you haven't been, you are really missing out on one of the finest dining experiences in Scottsdale. From valet, to being seated and through the entire meal, they treat you like royalty. The food is prepared perfectly and the outside views are AMAZING! We had the sole and the salmon. Both mouthwatering delicious! 
I'm looking forward to returning again in the near future. The wine selection was extensive and wine paring was available.
reviews.author: Krissie R.

reviews.text: What is not to like about J&G? We have a second home in Phoenix, so when we are in town, this is one of our absolute favorite places to go, enjoy a meal, and unwind. My husband and I like to sit at the bar for dinner. The service at the bar is outstanding, they always remember what we want, so helpful, and relaxed while being attentive. We have also dined in the restaurant, proper a few times, but prefer the bar. We probably been here 25 times or more in the last couple of years. It's one of our absolute favorites. we like it so much that when we are in town and we probably come once a week. in the food is outstanding. We like to start with the heirloom tomato salad and split it, do the truffle cheese fritters, sometimes I like a cup of French onion, and then we typically split the peppercorn New York and get the sauce, trio along with the baked potato. A few times we have a deviated, and tried things like the tuna, tartare, or summer ravioli, etc. Nothing we have ever eaten here has been anything less than great. My husband also likes to have an old fashioned or two. Excellent food, good service, nice vibe. You can't go wrong. Only things to keep in mind are that unless you are staying at the resort you need to valet park, and the restaurant does validate so don't forget to get that validation and just tip the valet. The other thing to know is that they do have live music usually once a week and it can be loud in the bar, but not terrible and that is usually on Saturday nights.
reviews.author: Michelle D.

reviews.text:
5 stars all the way! Hit this place up two nights in a row during our two night stay In Scottsdale lol because yes, it's that good! 
The ratio seems like it's literally 1:1 staff to patrons. Kudos to Austin, Scot D, Mike, and the entire tremendous staff! What a stellar team! 
My Man literally came for the fries he had tried and loved pre-Covid and 3 years later they did not disappoint either night! The fritters, Mac & cheese, Brussels and spinach are all amazing! The rib eye is to die for! The filet with blue cheese may just be the best filet I've ever had! The peppercorn sauce is also amazing! 
And the the gravy is the view! It's a painting that changes minute to minute as the sun goes down and the sky is GORGEOUS! 
The Friday night guitar player in the bar was also incredible. 
Take your date and grab a photo outside for sure. 
Enjoy- they really do a stellar job at J & G
(From Jen & Mo from Austin).  PS -congratulations Austin on ur engagement!
reviews.author: Jen W.

reviews.text: J&G Steakhouse has a wonderful view, layout, ambience, and staff. Everyone there treated us so well for our anniversary dinner. It was really a treat to be there. However, the food took over an hour to be served with maybe 4 other tables being hosted. My girlfriend's steak with rare, not medium-rare, and was hard to slice. The Brussels sprouts were a little over cooked as well. We think what happens was our order was not put in and then hastily made. We love the atmosphere but for the price we paid, it was a very underwhelming experience.
reviews.author: Nick E.

reviews.text: Beautiful views, great music, phenomenal service. Everyone was incredibly friendly - general manager came by to say hello and service was constantly checking on us. My family and I come here often and it hasn't disappointed. Our favorite server so far was definitely Austin! He was fantastic!
reviews.author: Heidy G.

reviews.text:
Delicious.   The parmesan crusted chicken is incredible.  We sat at the bar and received excellent service.   

Great atmosphere.   Beautiful location.   Friendly staff.
reviews.author: christy d.

reviews.text:
Our only regret was that we didn't come here the first night we arrived. The food is absolutely delicious. Well thought out and portioned.  Every bite was as perfect. The filet mignon literally melt in my mouth and the lobster was perfectly cooked. 
Becky was wonderful !! So sweet and helpful with the menu. Our compliments to the chef.
reviews.author: Natalie W.

reviews.text: Beautiful views, delicious food and great atmosphere! Definitely would do it again. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Sean K.

reviews.text: Great service, excellent food, delicious desert and a beautiful view to boot. I have eaten here twice and that says something.
reviews.author: Jaime R.

reviews.text: I've been to a lot of steakhouses, and have had really great steaks, OK steaks, and steaks I've sent back.  It is very, very common for me, when staying in a hotel, to not take the remainder with me... it's rarely worth the effort.  Last night, the second half of my ribeye came home with me!  It was seasoned and cooked PERFECTLY.  It was meat candy.  Definitely in the top 10% of steaks I've had!  We'll definitely return to the Phoenician and this restaurant.
reviews.author: John O.

reviews.text: It was my birthday and my husband was looking to spoil me and my one-year-old son as we were staying at the Phoenician for a staycation for two nights. This is, by far, the fanciest dining option at the resort. It is not open on Monday or Tuesday, and you can get there by the elevator bay, only during operative hours. I was able to make my reservation, easily through OpenTable, however if you are a guest you can always book your reservation through the concierge as well. Upon arrival, we were led directly to our table that was beautiful, smack dab in the middle of the restaurant overlooking the entire Scottsdale, breathtaking view of the mountains. It truly is amazing for the view. I would highly recommend making a reservation as it does get booked up. A lot of people do work meetings and events there. There's a whole back space for that purpose. Our service was incredible, the menu boasted of so many delicious items it was hard to choose. They also have a great, healthier version of a kids menu that was nice for my son. He ordered the grilled chicken with broccoli. I had the salmon with slow roasted vegetables, my husband ordered fish as well as we shared the crabcakes for an appetizer. I had my birthday martini, and my husband ordered bourbon on the rocks. My son had some milk so that we could all cheers. They brought over a complimentary chocolate cake dessert that was yummy as well. All together, we were in and out in about an hour. The service worked very quickly. They were very accommodating to my son. If ever staying at this resort or nearby, I would definitely go here again.
reviews.author: Addy G.

reviews.text: This place is awesome and the view is incredible. This place is great for a special occasion or just if you want a spectacular dinner. The food is superb. My steak was cooked perfectly and the flavor was delicious and it was absolutely the best quality. Try the roasted mushrooms because I've never tried them before and they were delicious. Highly recommend this place if you're staying in this area.
reviews.author: Jeff G.

reviews.text: I can't say enough good things about this place. For starters everyone was very attentive and friendly. We were seated by a great view. Onto the best part..the food! It was amazing from beginning to end! The lobster Mac and cheese was to die for! They brought out a delicious birthday  treat too!  Such a great place to dine and celebrate special occasions.
reviews.author: Maria M.

reviews.text:
The hotel itself is outdated architecturally speaking. The decor has been upgraded and is enjoyable. The prices are very high and they attempt to provide the service to match them. Our $155 wagyu tomahawk steak was delicious however it was not cooked to order and had to be sent back... We were not offered anything to make up for this faux pas. Also the asparagus was steamed and not grilled. It lacked flavor and was a low point of the meal. If it was roasted with olive oil and salt it would taste a lot better. We celebrated our anniversary and we're given a small chocolate molten Bundt cake with caramel ice cream as a gift as well as a card from the wait staff. That was nice but flavor wise the desert was moderate, nothing to return for. 

Some negatives: Our waters were never refilled. The live music was performed well but Style that did not enhance the ambience but rather detracted from it. 

Some positives: Making reservations was easy and a last-minute change I was kindly accommodated. Staff was friendly. The view was beautiful. The steak flavor were woody and texture tender. The macaroni and cheese was the highlight of the meal, it was  absolutely delicious.
reviews.author: Candice F.

reviews.text:
Wanna be but not gonna be 

If you are a captive at this hotel and think they have a great steak house then think about ordering an Uber and going elsewhere.  Food is mediocre but priced at a point where it should be exceptional.   Lacks much of anything worthy of the price tag but if you create enough hype or have enough corporate clients you can mark up the price from average to premium without complaint.  Skip it and go somewhere else.
reviews.author: Jason K.

reviews.text: My husband took me here for appetizers and dinner. Absolutely delicious. We will definitely return. Guacamole and salsa were the most tasty,  though the chips a little to salty. My ribeye steak cooked to perfection   husband's sea bass exceptional. We also ordered the asparagus risotto appetizers with our dinner!
reviews.author: Christina S.

reviews.text: Dinner here was great and would highly recommend!! They take reservations but are usually booked out a few weeks so get in early.
