Amazing spot for sunset and the patio is a nice spot to eat (a little buggy once the sun went down). We ordered the truffle fritters to start and they were sooooo good. They're a perfect bite size savory snack before dinner! For dinner we got the Parmesan crusted chicken (amazing), their special which was a grade 9 Australian wagyu 6oz filet (not pictured), asparagus, potatoes au gratin and Mac. Our highlight surprisingly was the Parmesan chicken. Such a delightful dish with so much flavor but wasn't too heavy. You got two pieces of chicken - one white meat and one dark. The sauce that came with it was delightful as well! My four stars is because while we thought we'd like the fancy steak the most, everything else beat it out. The sides were great, traditional au gratin and very creamy sharp Mac and cheese! For dessert we got the cobbler which was delightful and would recommend if you like a fruit forward dessert to end your night. Overall we had a good experience; service wasn't slow, food came relatively fast and awesome atmosphere if you go for sunset!!
reviews.author: Sam T.

reviews.text: We have been here three times now. The views are gorgeous! The menu is very gluten friendly and it is very transparent on what is gluten free so I don't have to ask a lot of questions especially when we are with friends. Service is always great. Though it makes for a perfect date experience, they do offer a kids menu. With our little ones food sensitivities they allow us to order an adult meal for them to share. They love their steaks, lobster, Potato Gratin with Comte cheese and broccoli. We all enjoy the ambience and our girls LOVE eating at the restaurant. Reservations are a must. You don't have to be staying here to enjoy any of The Phoenician's eateries. You can call to make reservation with your ambassador if you are assigned one or the concierge if you are a guest at the resort, use their website. They are open  Wednesday-Sundays. Check their holiday schedule! Our well traveled friends had Christmas dinner here and and really enjoyed.
reviews.author: Jessica S.

reviews.text: Came here with a few friends, we were staying at the hotel this restaurant is located in. The good: Cocktails, atmosphere, view, ambiance, service, appetizers, some of the side dishes. The bad: The steaks!! 3 of us had the filet mignon, 2 of us had the Six Peppercorn prime. They have steak sauces to use and those didn't help either. Maybe it was just an off night but 5 different people all felt the same way. The filets had no flavor and the six peppercorn just had a strange flavor, maybe just not right the cut? If we come again, we will try other entrees. Also, the bread was too dry and the creamed spinach left much to be desired. But back to the good: Best potato gratin we've ever had, hands down. Chilled lobster, heirloom tomatoes, crab cake, and black truffle cheese fritters are def a must get again.
reviews.author: Lauren H.

reviews.text: I booked a reservation for my anniversary at J&G almost a month ago. I specifically requested outdoor dining, and the morning of the reservation they called to tell me my table was unavailable and that i would be seated inside. I asked for a nice table with a good view and they squished us in between two other tables. On top of that i paid for a crab cake to go and upon returning home and opening the box, al that was in there was a few leftovers from dinner, no crab cake. I spend over 400 dollars on dinner and left extremely dissatisfied. Will not recommend or return.
reviews.author: Brian M.

reviews.text: This is amazing!!! Please make sure to enjoy this fantastic place. From the view to the service and the food is amazing! It is an experience!!!  My server Paul was 1000% fantastic
reviews.author: Krysta W.

reviews.text: Excellent service, attractive and engaging menu. I like the Phoenician and it's restaurants.
reviews.author: John M.

reviews.text:
Sadly, food was all very bland, basic and uninspired.   We ordered oysters and truffle cheese bites which were the highlight. Caesar salad included yellow lettuce and cheap croutons. None of the food has any seasoning. View is nice but would recommend coming before sunset to enjoy that fully. The lobby and conference areas of the resort and the restaurant desperately need to be updated aesthetically and menu-wise as it's all very dated and not in line with expectations from a Scottsdale restaurant or resort.

Came for a birthday, and they didn't do anything special except give a card. We spent $300 and should have left after the bad dinner rolls haha. Definitely a lot better restaurants nearby so do not waste your money here.
reviews.author: Marissa H.

reviews.text:
I chose this location based on the lackluster performance of other fine dining locations I've visited since 2020. Our first vacation in over ten years warranted a steakhouse that wasn't going to disappoint. It figured that venue within a hotel would be less impacted by staffing situations than a stand alone restaurant. I was not disappointed...

First of all, the location is amazing. You really feel like a VIP when you pull up to the hotel property. You enter the building and have to take an elevator up to the steakhouse itself. I love that sort of thing, especially after all this time not traveling and being at home.

The restaurant is beautiful and has a great view. I had wanted to sit outside, but that will have to wait for a future visit. Our table was outstanding though.

Our server, Austin, made it a point to take care of us. He was cheerful, attentive, and never great bored with us. You can read my previous reviews to see why this was so appreciated. 

The food itself did not disappoint. My partner ordered the Tomahawk all for himself. This was to make up for our lackluster experience earlier in the month. I tasted his steak and it was definitely better than where we had dined the week before!! We also didn't have to worry about our leftovers being returned to us. My rib-eye made up for the lackluster steaks that I have experienced since returning to fine dining over the past six months. It was honestly a relief to just have a meal that didn't disappoint. You would think that isn't a difficult bar to reach when you're at a restaurant of this caliber, but other places I have been to aren't hitting their mark. 

Lastly, the people watching was fantastic! I have always enjoyed this aspect of fine-dining, but it was even better the night we were there. The check jockeying between the two old male friends; the Steven Segal look alike who was desperately trying to impress his date; and the birthday party who brought gifts. I've missed all these things we used to take for granted. I can't wait to return.
reviews.author: Gabby R.

reviews.text: Very disappointed in our dining experience at J & G. We were seated promptly but sat for nearly 15 minutes before being greeted by a server or being offered water. The server was very unfriendly & failed to offer the option of still or sparkling water or bread for the table as we'd seen the kind server at another table offer as they promptly greeted their guests. He then disappeared after taking our drink order. While waiting for quite awhile we asked another server for bread for the table. When our waiter finally returned with our drinks, he served them and walked away...he didn't ask if we had questions on the menu or make any recommendations. He was very unpleasant. Another server came to our table after another 30 minutes asking if we needed anything. There were several servers & it didn't seem extremely busy so its hard to imagine why we received such poor service. We mentioned that our server hadn't returned and she offered to take our order, however, she was not pleasant either. The service at this establishment was so poor! We placed our order then waited nearly 40 minutes before asking another server if they could check on our order. Our food finally arrived an hour and 45 min after we arrived by our initial server. Several patrons were waiting and another table expressed concern although we saw a table seated near us with a larger party who was greeted and served their dinner ahead of our table and others though we'd all been waiting. The food was ok but not nearly worthy of the price or service. I took my husband here for his birthday to try a different option rather than his yearly request to dine at Mastros. This experience did not compare with the exception of the beautiful view. I've never left such an extensive review but I want to inform others of my experience in case they are planning to dine here. I'd especially discourage planning a celebratory dinner here. They greeted us with a card for my husband & they were timely with a complimentary birthday dessert but the service in between our arrival & departure is not fitting of a fine dining experience.  The view is amazing and a very delightful server took our photo before we left. That was the best service we received on this visit.
reviews.author: Tondra R.

reviews.text: If you live in AZ, think twice about giving your business to J&G. I called them weeks ago and actually made a reservation for New Year's Eve. I just received  a call saying if I am not staying at the property that my reservation will not be  honored. "Say what?!" Sounds "wrong", right? J&G is only honoring reservations for people staying at the property. So weird. I live in AZ and can give J&G business all year round. Oh Well. My love affair with this spot is O.V.E.R. Good luck J&G when the pandemic is over. Don't call me and I promise, I won't call you.
reviews.author: Valerie Z.

reviews.text: Excellent Service, Extremely Polite Staff, and Delectable Choices. I wanted to try several things, so I ordered the bone-in ribeye, sautéed spinach, French onion soup, & shrimp cocktail. I ate the majority of it throughout the next day and it still had a great taste even after the microwave lol. The waiter helped me choose some delicious cocktails as well.
reviews.author: Lola J.

reviews.text:
What a perfect atmosphere to celebrate a special occasion. My friends and I met from across the US in Scottsdale to celebrate our 50th birthdays. We were not disappointed in the least.

I have to talk about the special occasion dessert first. I have been to many luxury restaurants to celebrate occasions. This was the best complementary occasion dessert that I have seen to date! The molten chocolate dessert with ice cream and a candle was delicious- the chocolate was not sweet it was done perfectly- came to the table still molten in the middle and we were so touched by the lighted candles. We held hands around the table dramatically as we blew them out and really just had quite a special moment here. 

The miso Seabass was tasty, the tuna tartare was presented nicely with a slightly overpowering but tasty sauce... perhaps on the side would be better for me next time. The breaded chicken was crispy and rich and tender on the inside. We were impressed by our waitress who mentioned that it was a very big portion so two people split that by the way with her helping us make a wine choice and telling us about the large portion I felt like she was quite generous with us to be straightforward and respect our price points and not try to get us to order extra food to increase a gratuity like some may do in other places
The wagu steak was the Stand-out order by far. I've actually had an unimpressive wagu in the past- there are ways to miss bring out the best of it but in this case it was wonderful.
The stand-out side dish was the mashed potatoes and I dare say that they are the best mashed potatoes I have ever come across.
I left not quite being able to try the apple old-fashioned that I would've ordered had I been asked for another drink order halfway through my meal I guess I'll just have to return! I was impressed to see my favorite type of Mezcal drink on the menu and left half of it so I bet it looked like I didn't need another drink.
The reason for one less star is because the salads were lacking. They were not lacking in size they were huge- actually large enough to make me a little suspicious if that makes any sense...  they were too big which is such a weird thing to say now that I'm saying it out loud. The Caesar salad lacked flavor and it could've been mistaken for a salad at a much lesser place. I love seeing an heirloom salad on the menu. I don't know if there was some sort of hummus on the bottom of the salad but it did not complement the tomato. I would have rather had smaller salads With more refined flavors rather than such a large portion.
Thank you for making our evening so special. The chairs and space were a comfortable dining room feel with beautiful views. We will never forget our time here.
reviews.author: Michele S.

reviews.text: I come here EVERY time I'm in phoneix.  I love the hotel and have rated this place very high before.  I arrived to my 815 reservation at 650.  Yes i was early but hungry. So I asked the hostess I'd love to be seated early since the restaurant wasn't crowded.  She said she'd see and you wait in the bar.  At 815 I went back up and ask to be seated.  She said I needed to wait 15 more minutes.  There are many open seats and I can't have one?  After more rudeness from her I went else where.  Then I get an email from open table where JG reported I no showed on my dinner reservation.  TACKY I will avoid the entire chain after this treatment.
reviews.author: Tommy L.

reviews.text:
Great staff! Amazing views! Delicious food that will please any palate.  We tried the salmon and the seabass, as well as the heirloom tomatoes. They proved to be great choices. Very welcome ambience. 

J&G is Located on the 5th floor inside of the Phoenician Resort. Valet parking available.
reviews.author: O'Zandra F.

reviews.text: I wish i could give them zero stars. We called ahead of time for reservations and to ask if they allow service animals, the very nice lady on the phone said as long as we have her verification and papers we are ok to dine there. As we got there for our reservation at 8:30 we were told to go sit in the waiting area while they got our table ready, everything was going fine then Patrick from the front desk comes over and tells us we can't have dogs in the restaurant which i would understand but however, she is a veterans service animal WITH PAPERS, may i add Patrick did not care and asked for our medical condition which is highly disrespectful and we don't have to disclose that kind of information. So, we told Patrick that we have her service dog verification and all the paperwork and we even offered to sit on the patio and didn't even care to ask for her verification, and he still didn't let us dine at the restaurant. So we left in disgust and instead went to Mowry and cotton which is in the same hotel and the hotel lobby bar which is in THE SAME HOTEL... and they welcomed us with open arms and we're very sweet and respectful towards us. We are highly disgusted and dissatisfied in his manners and how he handled the situation to our veterans service dog. We will NEVER be going back.
reviews.author: Shea E.

reviews.text:
The J & G Steakhouse is located within a beautiful resort (The Phoenician) . The location and ambiance is perfect for special occasions and celebrations but is also an excellent choice for a nice dinner during your resort stay.  We opted for a elegant Saturday night meal.  The meal began at a slow pace. (We are from the East Coast) We expressed our expectations to the hostess and the restaurant manager Kevin took charge of the situation,  he explained the dinner specials, and made sure we had beverages and bread. Once our server Paul took over the superior customer service continued. 5 stars for customer service.  
The food is phenomenal! We  began with an appetizer sample of Black Truffle Cheese Fritters. Very interesting marriage of flavors.. We choose the specials a waygu filet mignon and bison  ribeye. The ribeye was huge, tender, and full of flavor. The filet barely needed a knife for cutting.. I have never tasted a filet so intensely flavorful and satisfying and its not for lack of trying because I love beef.. Paul asked if we wanted steak sauce or other condiments but we declined because the meat was so delicious it would be an insult to the chef to hide the flavor under any sauce. 
We ended the meal with dessert of warm chocolate cake and pear cheesecake with a cranberry and grand Marnier sauce. The deserts are phenomenal!!! We came back the next night just for dessert and yes we waited an hour just for that. This meal was so delicious and the experience so amazing that I enjoyed myself so much I didn't take any photos! The establishment exceeded my expectations, my taste buds were epically intrigued bite after bite! My compliments to Chef Jaques Qualin well done!
reviews.author: Lorrice G.

reviews.text: My husband, son (15) and I had the tasting menu.  Every item was amazing!  We couldn't decide which was our favorite.  Will definitely have to come back and try more items.  Laurie was a wonderful server and the entire night was first class.  Thank you.
reviews.author: Lynn K.

reviews.text:
Nice looking hotel but the lobby is a restaurant. As i sat to wait for my party to arrive a mean lady came took my order and wanted me to pay right away before we got out items. Fine!

Sat there and enjoyed drinks and stuff and my party arrived so we sat and enjoyed our time. About an hour later the lady stomps back and said we never gave her a tip and she lost so much money by us "hogging" a table!

Part of our party was checking out this expensive 5 star hotel while the waitress was guilt tripping us and asking for money and I responded with "okay let me just find everyone and we will leave" i even apologized to her for "hogging" the table.

She said "oh thats okay just give me some money" luckily someone asked for her help so she left momentarily. When she was done she stood at the corner and just stared at us. For like 10 minutes. After our party came, i suggested we leave and the lady stomped in front of us blocking our way, looked at the table, and asked "oh so you're not going to leave me any money"?

As my party each looked at each other, the lady just said that she sees what kind of people we are and we are never allowed back.

We managed to make it to our cars but let me tell you, that experience bothered me all night and the rest of my vacation. Her voice, her attitude, her attack, her actions, all seemed wrong.

My advice, just stay at a homeless shelter or under a bridge. Much better service will be given there!!!
reviews.author: T B.

reviews.text: Overall a solid steak house. Not amazing, but was good. The inside of the restaurant and views inside are great. A nice and open feeling. The service was also great. The food was just good. I got the lamb T-bone, which was a 4/5. My wife got the sirloin, and French onion soup. The soup she said was 5/5, sirloin 4/5. Overall glad we came, but at this price point they didn't deliver enough to warrant a return trip.
reviews.author: Grayson W.

reviews.text: I went to celebrate my birthday and I was not disappointed. I've been to many steakhouses and J&G might be my new favorite. The service was amazing and the food delicious. I started with the wedge salad which was really good. For my entrée I ordered the peppercorn prime NY steak. It was cooked perfectly and the peppercorn added such a great taste. We shared the grilled asparagus and the lobster shell and cheese, both were really good. They also brought me a chocolate cake and ice cream to celebrate my birthday. I would definitely recommend this restaurant and can't wait to go back.
reviews.author: Lidia M.

reviews.text:
Tuna tar tar, black truffle cheese fritters and our favorite wagyu beef. All delicious!! The tuna tar tar was amazing, definitely don't miss out on that! I had a reg margarita and Hubby had a ginger margarita which he said was really good. Our waitress suggested a fantastic bottle of wine with our dinner and the dessert she suggested didn't disappoint either. Chocolate cake with a scoop of caramel ice cream and a scoop of vanilla.  Sooo good! 
We sat at a table by the bar because there were no tables available when we called last min. I would suggest going right when they open if you are wanting to experience this steak house and their beautiful views. Might get lucky and get a table like we did.
reviews.author: Dee M.

reviews.text: Beautiful atmosphere and great food. Gave us a free mini soup before dinner as well to sample and it was delicious! Server forgot my glass of wine and when I reminded him he went and grabbed me a nicer glass for free instead! Can tell that reputation and high class service is important here. The waiter was very friendly and attentive for the entire dinner, despite forgetting the wine. The view of the resort's pool from our table was really nice to see and we were let on to the balcony to enjoy our drinks after dinner. Definitely will come back if we are ever in AZ again!
reviews.author: Kelly M.

reviews.text: My family and I have been here a few times and have always had wonderful experiences. The tomahawk ribeye is among the best meats I've ever tasted and the sides are usually exceptional. On our most recent visit, the asparagus risotto was a particular standout. Also the desert views from the patio seating are amazing and make for a striking backdrop to the meal.
reviews.author: Marc L.

reviews.text:
Had dinner there Sunday night May 2, 2021, hands down, the quality of the food as well as preparation, was one of the top three restaurants that i had the pleasure to dine in,  better than some of the top restaurants in Vegas.

i had the Sole, deboned table side and the vegetables were so fresh, peas swimming in butter.......awesome.
reviews.author: LV Guy Y.

reviews.text: The food was good, not great. Overpriced for the quality and presentation. We really liked the calamari and the mashed potatoes. I ordered half lobster with the ribeye, but they don't include the lobster claw. So it's really a third of a lobster. The ribeye was okay, but again, not worth the $70.  Service was not good. Waiter seemed annoyed when we asked questions. She was borderline rude and seemed only to tolerate our presence. Not what you'd expect from the quality of hotel.
reviews.author: David L.

reviews.text: Was excited to check this place out and see the views.  We were able to make a reservation for patio seating and it was beautiful.  Dinner was the wagyu grade 9 steak followed with carrot cake.  Truly well worth a visit!  The wine list is extensive and the service was top notch!
reviews.author: A C.

reviews.text:
5 star everything as always!! 
Our server David was great and absolutely on point for every need. 
They have a appetizer special right now that I'm lobbying to get added to the menu permanently! 
Lobster Ravioli!!!! It's unbelievable!
reviews.author: Gerald J.

reviews.text:
In the Top 3 steaks I've ever eaten.   Service is impeccable.  And the food is beyond reproach. 
If you haven't eaten here your missing an amazing dining experience.
reviews.author: Curtis C.

reviews.text: We went to eat for my birthday and we brought our nine month old. Our experience was fantastic. The view was amazing and the staff from the girls at reception to the wait staff to the managers. It was all great. They stopped by to play peek a boo with my daughter which kept her entertained. The food was delicious and we will be going back. Definitely recommend!
reviews.author: Allison C.

reviews.text:
Ah, I really had high hopes for this restaurant. The entire customer service experience and food at the resort was wonderful until we got here. 

The great: the black truffle cheese balls were amazing. Also great martinis and a robust wine list. My friend had the tomato salad and said it was wonderful. Most of the staff was fantastic. 

The good: the fish dishes that we had were solid. Not overly exciting, but good. A rich sea bass was very delicate and had a flavorful miso sauce. The sole was cooked to perfection and had good flavor. The gratin potatoes were pretty good but their sautéed spinach had way too many stems and could use a little more flavor. 

The ick: their Caesar salad is abysmal. The croutons were bland and not cooked well. The dressing was flavorless. It was one of the most pedestrian Caesar salads ever. And then the service - our waitress was just bad. She often got confused, and was extremely rude. Not in line with the great customer service that the Phoenician provides. 

Great COVID protocols.
reviews.author: Lisa R.

reviews.text:
My husband and I ate a lovely dinner at the bar on Sunday evening.  Abby was amazing at offering menu suggestions and was also very attentive to our needs.  The food was amazing-from the shrimp cocktail to; our steaks and sides.
We will definitely be back
reviews.author: Melinda B.

reviews.text:
First and most important was the staff friendly greeting as we walked in and the service at our table outside was also outstanding our food was delivered on time and at the same time we had a 12 once filet cooked perfectly rly and it was served at perfect temperature 
Our fish was prepared and cooked perfect also and our deserts were also great
Celebrating half point for chemo for my daughters battle with breast cancer
reviews.author: Alan F.

reviews.text:
Jeff is hands-down the best server - we've dined at many Michelin-starred restaurants in NYC including Jean George, and Jeff's affable nature made my birthday dinner memorable. 

The sea bass was exceptional and perfectly complimented the sauces. My girlfriend even claimed it was the best fish dish she's ever had (and she's had an ample sample size). My 16oz six peppercorn prime NY steak was sublime paired with the Asian-styled sauces and was in harmony with a California red blend. 

Jeff's personal touch and generosity (free appetizer and birthday cake) made the night wonderful. Would highly recommend to visit for a birthday or a special night out
reviews.author: Kevin W.

reviews.text: Exceptional service. Came here on Friday and Jeff our server was amazing! Went above and beyond and was hilarious. Next time I go I will request him
reviews.author: Holli G.

reviews.text: My husband and I celebrated our 33rd wedding anniversary at J&G and were lucky enough to have been seated at an outside table overlooking the magnificent pools of the Phoenician Resort, as well as the city lights.  The steakhouse just reopened after an extended COVID forced lockdown (8 months) and are doing an amazing job with keeping people safe, guests and employees.  The social distancing they've implemented is actually more than required.  All employees wear face masks and gloves and all areas inside and outside the restaurant are constantly being disinfected.  Our waiter, Austin, was extremely knowledgeable about both the food and wine menu, was friendly and attentive, and made us feel like royalty.  We can't wait to go back to J&G and the hotel itself to enjoy, what we feel, is the most beautiful resort/hotel property in the Valley.
reviews.author: Jane Z.

reviews.text: The Phoenician's restaurant J&G Steakhouse is far more than just a steakhouse. It has an amazing selection of food, a top-notch dining experience, and the most beautiful views of the mountain and the city. Even if you're not staying at the Phoenician, I highly recommend you to reserve a table at this elegant restaurant. Everything we had there was wonderful! We especially love the truffle cheese fritters and, of course, their apple crumble.
reviews.author: Irina C.

reviews.text: Went for our Anniversary and had a wonderful experience. All the food was relatively light and it felt like they purposefully do that to let the natural flavors come through. Everyone who greeted us said "Happy Anniversary" and our server was exceptional! They Brought a chocolate lava cake for our anniversary, but I ended up getting the cheesecake as well because that's more my preference. I highly recommend the creamed spinach side. It was very fresh and not crazy creamy, but just enough.
reviews.author: Jenny M.

reviews.text: I really had high expectations for this place. The drinks were good but a little high to me since the food wasn't that great. One steak was undercooked but that happens. Another steak was really tough that I thought I have had more tender steak at outback. If I ever come back I want to try the chicken fried steak since so many people were having it.
reviews.author: Clint D.

reviews.text:
High prices but the service does not equate with what this place thinks it is . I don't want to ask for
Water and iced tea glasses to be refilled . I don't want 4 occupied tables at 5:30 to be on top of each other when the rest of the place empty. Long stretches of absent waitstaff. Failed to send one of the orders to the kitchen and then blamed the poor kitchen staff. And we didn't enjoy paper placemats that were subsequently picked up by busboy and crumbled with crumbs etc flying. The food is good but for the money and similar food we'll go where the experience is much more attentive and memorable!
reviews.author: Laura W.

reviews.text:
As good as it gets, awesome dinners here on both visit while we were here! 

Gorgeous space, great ambiance, nice bar, and gorgeous patio where I could watch the sunset, without dining in. As the AGZm Rasa or Rosa advised us. I'm grateful for it.

She even checked in with me to make sure we had a good time. Not once questioning my service dog! I offered my doctor paper regardless!

You don't have to be blind or physically disabled to get a service dog! And a dog don't need to be 70 lbs Labrador to be service dog!

I got ppl look at me weird and judged all day every day. They don't know what kind of illness I'm going through.

Not here, they were professional and gave me great service without judging me.

The food was so good, a bargain for what we had! The truffle ball was so good. Mashed potato was bomb good!

Strip steak at !40 was a bargain, perfectly cooked.

On my second visit, Lamb was under cooked, but they took care of it quickly.

Wine program was good. They don't allow BYOW which is really sad. But their by the glass was very well and fair priced.

Kumamoto was fresh, pork belly ginger & onion was delicious. 

Dessert wine by the glass was awesome for this part of town! 

Cocktail list was spot on. We love it! 

Service was excellent from start to finish. I've fined at many chef JG restaurants from from NYC to Las Vegas, from France to the UK.

This was such a nice surprised! Thank you.

Come before the sunset so you can enjoy it.

We saw a few cray guests didn't understand how Restos work, just BC tables empty, doesn't mean they can seat you! Bc they don't have empty servers based on booking/reservations!

Regardless we had a great time on both visits! Totally come back if we are in Scottsdale again!
reviews.author: Manda Bear B.

reviews.text:
Went to J&G steakhouse for Christmas dinner with my family.  J&G is located at the Phoenician which is an iconic resort in Scottsdale near camelback mountain. The views from the resort are incredible and I can imagine one of the best spots to be on New Years and the Fourth of July.  
The service staff is top notch, very professional. You definitely feel like it's a special place to be. 
The food is good but not the best I ever had. I think I was a little disappointed in the wagu steak. I've never had it before and thought it was time to try it out. The steak wasn't any better than any other steak at a nice steak house, in fact it was average. My dad had the filet and I tried his and it was much better, in my opinion. At least now I know about wagu and will get my normal rib eye or filet when I go out to such a place. Also, I'd prefer the tables be a little smaller for larger groups. I felt like the space between us was just large enough to make it difficult to converse with anyone not directly across or near to you. We did have a large rectangle table. They did have large round tables that would have done the job. All in all the experience was incredible and would be very keen to go back.
reviews.author: Scott S.

reviews.text: Wonderful dining spot.  Checked into Phoenician on Christmas Day has had a reservation at J&G that evening.  Beautiful dining room with striking views of Scottsdale.  We had excellent service and the menu and drink selection was impressive.  We had oysters and soup to start.  Cod fish and short ribs for entrees.  Food was well prepared and beautifully prepared.  A really great way to start our trip.  I highly recommend.
reviews.author: Adam R.

reviews.text: Well very disappointed in this place, very snobby and they think they are above us all, service was slow in the bar and only has one server, the beer we ordered was only half full in the glass, I ordered the heirloom tomato for my wife and asked if the could cook them the chef said no! What the hell! Why can't you just throw them on the griddle for a few minutes? Very lame, the NY strip I ordered was equal to a sizzler restaurant. Bill was $250 never going back
reviews.author: Mark C.

reviews.text:
Great meal!
Went with my boyfriend and parents. The view is pretty great if you can snag a table by the window.
The bread popover things were delicious!
Calamari portion was a little small, blue point oysters were delicious! 
As for the steaks - I had the filet 8oz which was cooked to perfection. I thought the seasoning was a little too peppery for my liking but I still wolfed it down! The mushrooms were good but I wish there had been more of a hearty sauce for them. Brussels sprouts also yummy.
For dessert, we split the carrot (just ok, wouldn't order again), warm chocolate cake (yum! definitely a good lava cake) and the real star was an apple cobbler with ice cream which was a large portion and delicious! Overall - great meal!
reviews.author: Jen A.

reviews.text:
The restaurant is fine. The views are beyond gorgeous. God help you if you have to sit in the bar for any amount of time. Not sure at what decibel level the live music is played but we had to leave because it gave me such a headache and my companion couldn't hear anything anyone was saying.
Maybe the music is quite good but it's soooooo bloody loud for such a lovely and romantic spot.
reviews.author: Patricia W.

reviews.text: We went here last night. Have been there many times before and service and food was great. But last night it was horrible. Our server had a rude look on here face all the time and never really came around our table. She made us feel so uncomfortable. My lobster was so small only about 3oz of meat. I made a mention to her and to talk to someone. No manger or anyone came by. My sons pork was way over done. The steak as well. They did not even care to offer any solution or compensation in any way. For a $500bill you think someone would care....No One still has called to care to even discuss the situation from the restaurant
reviews.author: Gina B.

reviews.text: Driving into the resort is absolutely gorgeous! You can see the view of the mountain and all the lights lighting the way to the entrance of the hotel is just magical. We had made reservations. While we are waiting at the lounge, there a band was playing they were wonderful. Our hostess came and took us to the table. I had asked if we can sit somewhere else, they said it wasn't opened. But in less than 5 mins, someone else ask they say them right away. That's was the only complaint I have. We ordered from the restaurant week. We had the most fabulous server. We started with our appetizers, I choose the Longevity Noodles with grilled wild shrimp swimming in ginger broth.  Entree flaky, Slowly Cooked Artic Char with a wood sorrel emulsion was cooked perfectly. How can I skip the best part, DESSERTS! Finally finished with warm chocolate cake with caramel ice cream. By this time I am absolutely full and unable to have any more decadent meals. I highly recommend to go here for date night, special occasion or just simply having dinners with good
reviews.author: Azuin R.

reviews.text:
Very expensive, but worth it.  Food, service and atmosphere were outstanding.  The charred corn ravioli appetizer in particular was out of this world.  Filet was very tender.  Will definitely return. 

We did return, for our anniversary.  This is my wife's favorite restaurant in the Phoenix area.  The ambiance, food and service are all spot on perfection.  When I made the reservation I requested a quite secluded table as it was our anniversary.  They don't really have anything like that so I wasn't sure what they would come up with.  Besides, most restaurants ignore such requests.  Most seat you according to their server rotation, period.  J & Gs however came up with a table that only had one other table next to it.  The entire time we were there, they sat no one at that table.  Now that's class.  That is customer satisfaction!
reviews.author: Kurt T.

reviews.text: This steakhouse was very great! The staff and the dining experience is 5/5. I ordered the lamb t-bones and my boyfriend had the salmon. We shared the side of asparagus because it was just enough between both of us. The wine I had was from California and paired well with the lamb. The only thing that they can do better with is the dessert, was expecting a little bit of a variety but kind of fell short. Other than that, I will be back!
reviews.author: Stephanie M.

reviews.text:
J&G Steakhouse is an upscale restaurant and steakhouse located in the Phoenician Resort. They offer a great variety of dishes some with global and Asian accents but done with French Technique. The Namesake of the restaurant is celebrity chef Jean-George Vongerichten and the current executive has worked with him. Several of chef Vongerichten signature dishes are on the menu. If the weather is nice you will want to make your reservation for the patio. Inside is also nice because they have large windows so you can see the view from your seat.

On this visit all the food we tried knocked it out of the park. Actually it was even better than that because it was restaurant week so it really was like more of a gift because we got more than what we paid for. It was truly amazing. Since these dishes are not on the current menu I will only mention what you can order.

We added the signature black truffle cheese fritters ($11.00). They are tiny but the taste is to die for. Six tiny marble size fritters with a crisp thin shell that holds the tastiest cheese ever mixed with black truffle shavings.

Other dishes we had were incredibly detailed and masterfully prepared and really delicious.

The chocolate cake with caramel ice cream is also amazing. I usually don't like chocolate desserts because they either use cheap chocolate or not enough chocolate but this one was perfection and came with delicious ice cream. 

Service was efficient and friendly.
reviews.author: Laura A.

reviews.text:
Excellent experience. It's restaurant week and date night, a great combination. We had reservations and in my typical style, well 70% of the time, we were 10 minutes late. We called and no worries, they held our reservation. Love that they offer self-parking without even seeing a valet. I'm always a bit embarrassed to tell them that I prefer to self park, but I don't like someone I don't know driving my 500hp car, Ferris Bueller flashbacks. The resort is beautiful. Even walking in from the parking garage is extremely classy. See picture. When the elevator reaches the 5th floor it opens directly into the foyer of the restaurant. It's like arriving at a private penthouse, really cool.

The inside is extremely well decorated, modern, spacious and beautiful. Hostess was super friendly and sat us up against the floor to ceiling glass wall overlooking the city from up on Camelback Mountain, the view was phenomenal, city lights as far as you can see. See pics. All the tables are set beautifully, candle, Pinot wine glasses, full settings. Nice! We grabbed a Tito's and soda along with a Beam and Seven, great start and went nicely with unlimited homemade fresh warm salted rolls with muffin like tops and homemade butter. Mmmmm!

During restaurant week, we paid $44 per person and each selected from a starter, an entree and a dessert. Check out the special restaurant-week menu picture. We started with the Warm Green Asparagus Salad and the Longevity Noodles. Asparagus was served cold and par cooked, a little smoky, covered in delicious sauce and seasonings. The Noodles were fantastic. 4 grilled shrimp, ginger consommé, homemade al dente noodles, greens, delicious! The menu didn't say it came with cilantro, which I hate, and they graciously replaced it without even a blink. Super well handled and the manager even came to check on us, no worries. Starters were great! I would normally not order a sirloin steak in any restaurant, but it was the only steak on the restaurant week menu, so we both gave it a shot. So glad we did! One was rare and the other was medium rare, both cooked perfectly, juicy, warm and probably the best sirloin steak I've ever had. Typically not a terrific cut of meat, but these were excellent. We also ordered a side of wild mushrooms, they were incredible, not drenched in any kind of butter, garlic or other sauce, the natural flavors came through and they were terrific! The Japanese eggplant was phenomenal, relatively soft, lightly smoky, fresh and flavorful. See the pics. Dessert was the "chocolate cake" which turned out to be a chocolate lava cake with caramel ice cream and a candied Brulé crisp, fantastic! Mine was carrot cake pie. Never heard of it, but how can you go wrong with carrot cake that's also a pie?! Lemon cream cheese frosting served with a sweet carrot reduction sauce. Oh, and toasted coconut ice cream! It was phenomenal! Soft, warm, rich, creamy,....mmmmmm! Check out the pics.

Service was excellent. We wanted for nothing and were promptly, yet unobtrusively taken care of by about 4 people plus our server. Everyone was extremely friendly and professional. Very well done!

Overall, this was a terrific value at $44 per person. Bill was $126 including a couple drinks and all. Would it be a 5 star review at $250? Probably not, but this was great. It's not Kai, but I don't think it tries to be. It's high-end, classy, comfortable, modern, clean with fantastic views overlooking an amazing property with high quality food and excellent service. Couldn't ask for much more.

I would absolutely return and recommend you try it too.
reviews.author: Steve A.

reviews.text: Solid 4 stars for this establishment. Valet is free if eating at the steakhouse. Gorgeous views, the resort is overlooking some of Scottsdale. Superb wait staff, smiles all around. We started off with the caesar salad [$12] which is a shareable starter along with a piece of their infamous bread. Enjoyed my (~19 oz) Rib Eye [$64], cooked just the way I wanted (med). The meat was so juicy and the marbling on it was spot on. The 8 oz Filet [$49] was a little overcooked (asked for a med, got med well), but my partner still enjoyed it. Although she did say she's had better steak... Opted for the J&G sauce which was a mixture of everything as our waitress said. Tasted similar to A1 sauce, just less commercialized. We ordered the sauteed spinach [$10] & the asparagus [$10] which were both "okay," nothing outstanding. Our waitress Ula was great, very attentive & even gave us a little surprise for our anniversary. The free dessert was chocolate molten lava cake w/ice cream. Absolutely decadent & one of the best parts of the night. Overall it was a lovely restaurant and experience.
reviews.author: Rana R.

reviews.text:
Terrible food which I am very surprised because it is inside the Phoenician resort property. Steak was overcooked and fatty and manager didn't do a thing about it gave us Desert's cream spinach had no flavor nothing about it was good the bread came as a little biscuit put on a plate to your table!
I would say outback is better!
Should have went to Mastro's
reviews.author: Lisa V.

reviews.text: We are in town for a conference. We travel a good bit for business and pleasure. This meal is in our top 2!! Ever6 from the bread to the dessert! Everything cooked perfectly, nothing left onour plates!
reviews.author: Michelle L.

reviews.text: This is a very nice restaurant. Nice views and great ambiance. I would recommend it for a special occasion. The food was amazing. I had Dover Sole and my wife had Filet Mignon. Both were excellent. Our server, Amy was terrific and treated us as if we were special.
reviews.author: Greg T.

reviews.text:
First time here. We were debating on leaving the resort for dinner or dining in. I normally don't have the greatest experiences at hotel steakhouses. However, this was the exception to the rule. 

I had the Prime Bone-in Rib Eye featured in my pic. It was incredibly tasty and cooked to perfect. I loved the dinner roll. Was adorned with salt. Salt simply makes life better. 

We are looking forward to coming back, especially for the views. Don't let them sit you anywhere other than in front of the window. @dukeofeats
reviews.author: Mike W.

reviews.text:
We are locals.  Been here many times.  They usually need to drum up business in the middle of the summer.  Went as a party of 4 to celebrate multiple birthdays.  Service was 5 stars.  Food was 5 stars (we had 2 of the summer specials and 2 of the tasting menu).  Waiter treated us to an extra dessert, which we didn't really need since we already had 4 desserts, but he gets props for doing something.  View was 5 stars.

Here's why only 3 stars: this is now the nicest restaurant on the property.  Phoenician.  Someone thought it would be a good idea to rent out the back room to a large group of the most productive Go Daddy salespeople, who were congratulating themselves for a job well done.  They were unbelievably loud!!!  Totally ruined the dining experience for the regular dining patrons.  Sounded like a frat party.  Couldn't hear conversation across the table.  Every minute there was whooping and cheering and napkin waving that only got even louder every time the door was opened.  Waiter assured us it would get quieter when their food was served.  Nope.

No manager came by to check on us or he/she would have gotten an earful.  I'm not optimistic that anyone at the Phoenician will even comment on this, but suffice it to say that what could have been a 5 star night was reduced to 3 stars by this loud group. They should have just closed the restaurant for the night.  Did I mention that this is the crowned jewel of the Phoenician?  Very disappointing.  Too many other high-end dining experiences begging for business in the middle of the summer in Phoenix.
reviews.author: Steve S.

reviews.text:
We went here for my birthday dinner and based on the menu presentation, we dressed nicely. We quickly found out we could have worn shorts like everyone else. 

I was taken back at how incredible loud this restaurant is. We could barely hear each other.

For such an upscale, luxurious resort, I was shocked.

Been there, done that.
reviews.author: Cheryl T.

reviews.text:
Wow what a disappointment.  I read and earlier review that said a-lot of money for a poor steak.  I thought hey guy buck up ...Good steaks cost money...i  am so sorry he was right !!!

I had the buffalo ribeye bone in $65 .  Now i travel all over the USA  and i know Phoenix is not Chicago or NY... this was a ponderosa steak at best!!!! Ridiculous even for Roadhouse or ponderosa  :-)

The waitress said "said i  am sorry" ??she compt my martini what i really wanted was a great steak!!

Do not come here for a great steak

Outback, roadhouse would be better by a mile !!!

I  not kidding .  Its not  the cost , frankly that is what led me to believe it might ne good steak. WRONG 

please i accepted that when i walked through the door THAT I WAS GOING TO PAY PREMIUM... but wanted premium .  I wanted great steak without  having to get in a cab




Terrible steak... great service 




Jeff
reviews.author: jeff s.

reviews.text:
We came without a reservation on a Friday evening around 8pm and had only a 10 minute wait. I ordered the "Charred Corn Ravioli" and absolutely loved it! It had a basil fondue which was to die for. It's hard to describe, similar to pea soup but creamier and richer. 

We also ordered the "Black Truffle Cheese Fritters" and the "Ginger Margarita" but I was not a fan of either. The margarita was far too sweet, and the fritters were nice and nutty from the truffle oil but were ultimately miniscule cheeseballs. I wish instead we had ordered another "Charred Corn Ravioli", yum! Highly recommend! 

There are multiple seating options. You can sit at the bar, by the windows for a view, in the lounge area with couches, in the dining room, or outside on the wrap around balcony. Really loved all of the options, made the space seem more dynamic and fun! And the hostesses were very hospitable and nice!
reviews.author: Natasha A.

reviews.text: The food in both restaurants in the Phoenician hotel was pretentious and ill-conceived.  I ordered a spring-mix salad with salmon.  The salmon was delicious.  The salad was wilted lettuce with the stems still attached and was a choking hazard.  I ordered chicken parmesan without the cheese which was a big mistake - I received two pieces of grilled, hard and dry chicken with mashed potatoes.  The dessert strawberry dish - came with exactly one cut up strawberry ( yes! 1 strawberry) with hard merengue decorating the plate.  The egg white scramble that was ordered for breakfast had raw greens on top of it - we had to discard the greens  Their fruit pancakes however were delicious.  For the food in this prestigious hotel to be rated higher, the menu had to be more varied, and delicious.  The staff were wonderfully trained and were very efficient and polite.  The executive chefs might need a wake-up call.
reviews.author: Sharon N.

reviews.text: This place has some of the best views around not to mention the culinary experience is stellar! The service is also impeccable with the waiters always being so attentive and knowledgeable on wines and meal options.
reviews.author: Kirin K.

reviews.text: Excellent service...delicious food...great ambience! Highly recommend! The view from the patio is beautiful at sunset so try and time your meal accordingly.
reviews.author: Linda S.

reviews.text: Let me start off by saying that my food was some of the best i have EVER had. The taster option had a perfect amount of 5 dishes which also looked gourmet. View was nive being on the 5th floor. Next time should try eating outside. My wife's parmesan crusted chicken was not too flavorful but her au gratin potatoes were good. Service was very friendly but there was am issue with my wife's order. She could not eat mushrooms or asparagus but the waitress was supposed to say if alternatives were available but didn't so she ended up being short on vegetables.
reviews.author: Jeremy G.

reviews.text: One of the best steak dinners we've had in quite some time! To start our server was amazing. She was extremely knowledgeable. Every time I asked her for recommendations she did not disappoint. (I hate when you ask a server for a recommendation and they cannot give you one besides "everything's good") The asparagus risotto was AMAZING. Our steaks were cooked perfectly. And the au gratin potatoes and beets were so flavorful. Highly recommend this place.
reviews.author: Katelynn S.

reviews.text:
The only thing that makes this place a high end steak house are the prices. The steak was so poorly executed that it needed sauces to mask the taste of failure. Sides were bland, bread rolls were cold, foie gras app was akin to canned pâté. 

3 stars for the view and decor. -1 stars for the food and prices. 

Do not trust these 5* reviews. You can get a better steak at Chili's.
reviews.author: Clay M.

reviews.text: Let me start out with saying you were not on par yesterday please note I don't feel are waiter was the issue with anything I am about to say. Took way to long to place are order for drinks 10mins and then waited another 20 mins to place are order. I believe you did not have enough staff on hand or you sat to many tables at one time we where at your restaurant  for over 2hrs. Food was on point.  I do love the view from your restaurant I did not plan on spending over 2hrs eating. Very disappointed on my birthday.
reviews.author: Jim K.

reviews.text: It was a good place with a amazing view. But the only problem I had was the wait on the food it took around a hour and fifteen minutes. But the staff was fun good and friendly. I got the lamb t-bone it was very tasty and had good flavor. Also the Mac and cheese was good.
reviews.author: Nick D.

reviews.text:
Staying at The Phoenician it is very convenient.
The bar experience is not good because it is not large and many people dine at the bar.
The night we were there it was impossible to get a drink with only 2 bartenders and the bar fill of people dining.

The restaurant is excellent and our server was super good.
I had Lamb  t-bones which were a first for me and trey were exceptional.

Great experience except the bar.
reviews.author: Ron M.

reviews.text: I love J&G. I go a few times a month and have loved it every single time! The service is amazing as if the food! The butternut squash soup is life.
reviews.author: Bonnie L.

reviews.text: The service was the problem. The wine and food were good, we had the tomahawk steak and it was excellent, we recommend it medium if you like midium rare. The waitress should have recommended that, but she didn't. She was slow getting our wine order after being slow greeting us. She failed to keep her head on a swivel and notice those she was serving. Once she delivered our dessert menus she never came back as we watched her walk past us 5X. Really just a service issue and for a resort trying to get a 5 diamond status we were really disappointed with the service.
reviews.author: Lance E.

reviews.text:
Took my dad for his birthday dinner here. Wonderful service. I mean you get up for the restroom and they refold your napkin, seemed weird at first then I realized it's how they keep their restaurant better than everyone else. Very formal. Our waiter Jeff was wonderful. 
The food excellent. We had, filet mignon, NY steak and the salmon. All delicious. 

We came a bit too late to see the outlook but it was wonderful. Fire pits at night, the resort pool lights change colors. So beautiful. 

Pricey, so I can't afford to be back until another special occasion lol.
reviews.author: Stephanie I.

reviews.text: The last time I was at the Phoenician for dinner I'm pretty sure it was my high school graduation family dinner. Needless to say my return was highly anticipated. I was relieved to see that they did a remodel which is beautiful (as it was looking rather tired) I believe it was a recent addition. The view and ambiance was fantastic and the staff was very attentive. I like how our server wrote our order on a little check pad (very back in the day) I appreciated it. Our group started with several shrimp cocktails and it was good and fresh (it's shrimp cocktail) you know what to expect. Calamari with basil salt had a good taste but I felt was too battered and the lemon dip I didn't care for, squeezing a lemon over the top was one thing but we all felt the dip made it slightly too tart. ENTREE...19oz Ribeye, the GOOD news is that it was prepared as requested medium rare the BAD news is that it was served on a cold plate. I prefer a hot plate, I will take a lukewarm plate I'd even settle for a room temperature plate.....but put a hot steak on a cold plate???? The steak also came with a variety of sauces, maybe it's just me but I don't think a prime steak needs any accompaniment so bringing it out without ordering it I felt was a waste. Asparagus with LEMON zest was good, broccoli with LEMON Parmesan mixed with my lemon sauce in the calamari I was about up to my ears in lemon. Side was very good macaroni and mushrooms I was just happy to taste something without lemon in it. Dessert was okay and they have good coffee, I thought about ordering tea but I was terrified they would bring me a lemon wedge and I'd have to run out of there screaming. BOTTOM LINE, the Phoenician sits smack between great steak houses on either side down the street, while it was fine I'll stick to those!
reviews.author: Clinton F.

reviews.text: We really wanted to like this place and were so disappointed. It was like a Sizzler playing at being a high-end steakhouse. The steak was tough no matter which one of us it belonged to, the brisket burger was chalky at best, the Mac-n-Cheese was truly like Stouffers, the wedge salad doesn't have a typical blue cheese dressing, it is a horseradish cream surprise. It was a $300 experience we won't ever repeat.
reviews.author: Mm S.

reviews.text: First time there was magical. The view was stunning. The service was on point. The food... simply amazing. At least once a year we end up here and it never disappoints. That's until the most recent visit. The waiter was rude. Not just rude to us the customers. He was rude to the runners. Got our orders wrong and didn't want to own up to his mistake. The food was mediocre, possibly due to the fact that it was near closing time. That being said, the warm shrimp salad is highly recommended, their steak is excellent and the salmon, Dover sole were all well prepared. Mix drinks are delicious and their brioche bread is likely 3000 calories but worth it. Though the last visit left a bad taste I'd still recommend it just hope you get a better waiter/waitress than I did. Horrible waiter took a star.
reviews.author: Yummo D.

reviews.text: Visited Mary Elaine's at the Phoenician many time in the past. This was our first visit to J&G's last night. The food was excellent. Highly recommend the food. Read some of the Yelp reviews before making a reservation and cannot understand why the reviews were so good. The ambiance was less than expected even with the nice views outside the windows. First the table had paper place mats just like Denny's and no table cloths. The chairs were extremely heavy and difficult to move and adjust to the table after sitting down. Unlike other restaurants when a patron wears dark clothes a dark or black napkin is provided to avoid lint on the clothing, the napkins were white and barely cover the lap. Even though the restaurant had been redecorated there was too many hard surfaces for sound to bounce off of. I could barely hear the people at my table while hearing well the people at the next table that were shouting to be heard. Some music started playing during dinner that sounded like a bar band. Not sure when it stopped because the noise made it difficult to hear any of it. Service was average and the bus staff was over eager to remove plates and glasses quickly. Not a good experience. I will not be visiting again.
reviews.author: Earl F.

reviews.text: Truly one of the great steakhouses in Arizona. Just remodeled and absolutely stunning views and service. Nice selection of all kinds of meat and seafood and junior sizes of great meat like the filet mignon were available. There were a multitude of side dishes and great looking desert menu, which we wished we had room to try. Try to go at sunset for some of the most brilliant colors I have seen.
reviews.author: Harris H.

reviews.text: Nice ambiance... great steaks.. once in a while you need to treat yourself.
reviews.author: Jesse C.

reviews.text:
Enjoyed husband's bday celebration here in December. The setting is modern, upscale and sexy with spectacular views all around. Perfectly lit, I might add (not too dim or bright).

From the unique cocktails in the lounge/bar area to our fantastic dinner and the night cap on the ground patio this was a true experience. Exactly what we were looking for. When your spending a few $$$ on dining, I like to soak it all in and take my time. Since this is on the grounds of the Phoenician there is plenty of beauty to admire.

Definitely arrive early for your reso's in order to spend 30 minutes in the lounge sipping on a specialty cocktail. We enjoyed all aspects of our dining experience and even though we were seated later than expected we never felt rushed.
- Kumamoto oysters - fresh and, as always, the perfect balance of mild brine and sweetness
- Shrimp cocktail - as expected
- Wagyu Tomahawk steak was grilled just right to medium rare and served with seared mini peppers - a nice touch! We liked that they sliced the steak tableside too. As steak "purists" we weren't a fan of the J&G Steak Sauce or the Hot Buttery Sauce (too sweet for our tastes) - though the signature offering was appreciated. 
- The Beets and Potato Gratin with Comte were tasty
- The warm bday chocolate cake with caramel ice cream was the perfect end to dining - it's more like a souffle/molten cake with it's light texture. Can I have another?!

Note, take care when ordering a Dirty Martini from the ground floor/patio area bar. I had to ask for extra olive brine to achieve the proper salty ratio of Tito's to brine. For $18 they should know how to make it perfectly!!
reviews.author: K F.

reviews.text: We had high expectations and also hope to make J&G our new steakhouse in Phoenix as we just moved to the area from Denver. The location and valet parking were great and the restaurant itself is well designed and comfortable. We were especially excited that the head chef is from Jean-George's. Then started the poor service. We waited a little too long for drinks and bread, but once we ordered appetizers our server disappeared for over 30 minutes. The restaurant was not full and we saw no big groups. No one came to check on us or give us an update. The food, once it arrived was pretty good. The steak was nice but not in the top ten as we might have expected. No apologies until we were walking out. Too bad.
reviews.author: Dan S.

reviews.text: This place is awesome. Great views, greatest service. What more could you want! Get the fritters!
reviews.author: Emily G.

reviews.text: My husband and I recently dined at J&G to celebrate our anniversary and we had an unbelievable experience. Austin was our server for the night and he was great and very knowledgeable and helpful with his suggestions. I have a gluten dietary restriction and they were very accommodating to this. I highly recommend the tasting menu, it is an amazing deal at only $67 for a 5 course meal and to that you can add a wine tasting for every course meaning 5 wine glasses for another $40!!! The manager Henry stopped by to check on us and wished us a happy anniversary. They also sent us a dessert and a happy anniversary hand written card from the general manager which was a nice touch. Will definitely recommend this restaurant to my friends and family and will be back again soon! Thank you!!!
reviews.author: Juli L.

reviews.text:
This was the best experience I have ever had at a restaurant. We went for a celebration of my daughter's birthday, and the customer service was amazing. Every person from the host, wait staff, and even managers came to our table to wish her a happy birthday. They really know how to treat their guests. 

Additionally, the food was outstanding. We began with fresh delicious bread and butter, with complementary hors d'oeuvres sent from the chef. I recommend the porterhouse steak, it is a large serving but absolutely worth it. The meat was incredibly tender and very flavorful. 

Lastly, and most importantly, the view is PHENOMENAL. There are no better views in the valley. I highly recommend.
reviews.author: Tina T.

reviews.text:
I recently visited J&G on two occasions for their 10th Anniversary promotion. Both evenings presented perfect proteins of the highest quality prepared lusciously en pointe.  Pork belly appetizers, salmon, filet, tenderloin, NY strip and lamb chops each was as hoped and the four sauces brought for the beef were a nice addition. Parker house rolls with sea salt were yummy. A beautiful panoramic view of city lights and roaring fires on the patio. 

The sides, soups, salads and desserts didn't live up to or enhance the enteees. Butternut squash soup was one note and the chopped salad was overly vinegar tasting. We tried six different sides and three desserts that were just additional bites. Warm bitter coffee on night one. 

The service each night was like two different restaurants. Tuesday had us sitting for four hours. Thursday the service and pacing was impeccable. A token to pick up the doggy bag and gracious birthday celebrating.  

A special event restaurant if you like resort living.
reviews.author: J. P.

reviews.text:
J & G Steakhouse at the Phoenician

Made reservations during their 10th Anniversary Celebration where many entrees we're $10.

Started out with the Crispy Calamari and Pork Belly. Calamari looked different but was very good as well as the Pork Belly had an excellent presentation and was as good as it looked.

10 oz Prime 6 Peppercorn New York Strip Steak (reg $44, $10), 16 oz Lamb T-Bone (reg $44/$10) and the 12 oz Filet Mignon Steak (reg $57, $15) all were of the finest cuts of meat, tender and juicy. The Peppercorn New York Steak was excellent and a wonderful tasting of beef. My 12 oz Filet Mignon was thick and juicy, as it was cut the juice just oozed out.

For our dessert we shared the J&G Cheesecake Cranberry Compote Quince Sorbet and Warm Chocolate Cake Caramel Ice Cream. The cheesecake was very good as was the sorbet but the warm chocolate cake with caramel ice cream was difficult to pick over. 

For just having a make over recent, decor looked dated, service was top notch, did not seem like our waitress did much but take our order and give us the bill, but the other people were there for everything.
reviews.author: Dwayne O.

reviews.text:
Dinner was lovely ! . Very beautiful atmosphere. The servants are very charming , professional and kind. Me and my sisters all ordered some thing different and enjoyed every thing together . Nothing better than a quiet and nice , easy going dinner.

P.s  The bread and butter is so good lol
reviews.author: Princeya P.

reviews.text: The only reason for the 4 is because the menu didn't have enough selection for non steak eating customers.  I know it is a steak house but sometimes people take someone that is a steak lover but don't eat steak.  Also the view is ok but not fabulous.  The service was good but not great. However the manager did come to say hi and check on is and also they provided a nice cake for my moms bday.  It wasn't busy and we were able to enjoy some wine out by the fire.  The sides were almost better than the main meal.  I recommend the cheesy potatoes and the huge asparagus.  My expectations are always very high for a nice restaurant.
reviews.author: Wendy K.

reviews.text:
This is a very special place . We were married at the restaurant a year ago and Elena Torres the events  manger helped to make this day the most special in our lives . Not just being married on the restaurant balcony at sunset but helping up with all of the food and flower details as well . 
 We went back to the same restaurant on our one year anniversary yesterday and were greeted with complimentary champagne and a few other touches that made us feel welcome and appreciated. We are grateful to Elena Torres and the other restaurant staff for making both events magical . The food was superb , the view spectacular and the atmosphere untouchable .   We will certainly look forward to many more celebrations here in the future .   
Scott & Galina
reviews.author: Galina P.

reviews.text: The steak is always perfectly well cooked and the drinks are amazing!  Great bar atmosphere for pre-dinner drinks as well!
reviews.author: Shannon C.

reviews.text:
Myself and my guests were greeted by the manager Patrick, who was amazing, promptly sat us and presented a birthday card for me.  The restaurant and property is absolutely stunning.  David S, our server was friendly, knowledgable, and provided excellent service.  The chef delivered the table an appetizer which was fantastic along with the calamari we ordered.  My guests and I all enjoyed steaks, perfectly cooked, cut with a butter knife, melted in mouth delicious, served with a variety of different sauces which were compliments from David S.  The sides were beyond spectacular. Enough for the three of us to share.  After dinner, a beautiful dessert was served along with a complimentary dessert.  Overall my experience for my birthday was the best birthday dinner ever.  

Side note - one of the employees from the Camelback lobby assisted us to the restaurant, I did not get her name, but she was lovely.  
Thank you to the hotel management for your wonderful superb top notch employees.
reviews.author: Neysa C.

reviews.text:
What a disappointment! Located inside the Phoenician Resort on the 5th floor. Beautiful resort, but where are all the people?  No resort employees visible. Couldn't figure out where the restaurant was, no one in the entry to ask questions.  Then, how do you operate the elevator?? This was really strange. Most high tech elevator I have been in, you don't push any buttons once inside, and when we left the restaurant, couldn't figure out how to get back to the lobby area!

We arrived within a few minutes of reservation which was 6:45 PM. It was not very busy. After we were seated, the beverage girl came by with water. That was it!  We waited for at least 30 minutes before we even saw our waiter, Really bad. He kept walking behind us, but never came and introduced himself.  It was ONE HOUR after we were seated before we were served.  We sat there with absolutely NOTHING to eat! no bread, no crackers, NOTHING! The food server brought us our food, served it (still no waiter) and left. No one came by to check on "how is everything".  Finally at 8:30 (remember we arrived at 6:50) we asked for our check and left.  If the service had not been so bad we would have had dessert. As it was, our bill for 2 people was $200!! Horrible experience.  Food was good, but $66 for filet of sole? really? not sure why it was so expensive.  The meat was less. Everything was a la carte. We had asparagus, mashed potatoes and bernaise sauce, all which was in addition to the entre.

By the time we left, it was busier. This was for a Wed evening. I don't know if the other tables got better service or not, but I would not come here again. Plenty of other choices. The service in this hotel overall is awful!
reviews.author: Sonya B C.

reviews.text: Indoor /outdoor seating available at this busy delicious restaurant. We weren't able to secure a great table w a view ( we made a last minute reservation) but enjoyed the service and food very much. The pretzel pop up type bread prior to your meal was delicious served with butter.  The salads, chicken and steak dishes we all had were very good. The sides will be extra and we tried a few that were enjoyable.  The staff was very accommodating and friendly and we enjoyed our meal.
reviews.author: Jill R.

reviews.text:
We have been to the Pheonician a couple of times in the past but this was our first visit to the steakhouse. We were visiting from Hawaii and I wanted to treat the in-laws to somewhere special, and it was a hit! Incredible food with one of the valley's best views.

The food was of course wonderful. Truffle fritters were my favorite appetizer we tried, but the ahi tare tare was a close second. Living in Hawaii we get a lot of great raw seafood dishes, but this was the best ahi tare tare I've had. Filet Mignon Steak was cooked to perfection, but the highlight for me was the C02 injected bearnaise sauce. It was so light and flavorful, and not overly rich and heavy like a lot of places have. 

The service was nothing short of amazing as to be expected at such a place. I go through a lot of water, and my glass was never less than half full. Sitting with an empty glass is a bit of a pet peeve of mine, so I was quite impressed by the hyper attentive staff. 

A special thanks to our server Austin who was quite knowledgable about the food and beverages and answered all of our questions. Wonderful experience and successful dinner and it started and ended with our great waiter Austin and the professional staff at J&G steakhouse. 10 out of 10, will be back next time we're in town.
reviews.author: Bryce K.

reviews.text: My family and I have been dining at J & G for several years and mostly on special occasions. The food and service has always been top notch until last week. We went to celebrate my wife's birthday as J & G is her favorite restaurant. She and my son ordered the Dover Sole but after waiting some time the waiter came over and told us one of the Sole's had to be remade and would we like to get the one that is done to split in the meantime. My wife and son did not want that so we waited. When the soles came out my wife's was luke warm but she did not want to wait and send it back. I decided I was in the mood for chicken so I ordered the Parmesan crusted chicken. When it came out of the kitchen it was like shoe leather and did not taste good at all so I only ate half of my meal. I'm surprised the chef would have let that leave the kitchen. It was something that I would expect from a Denny's, not J & G. They did comp us on desserts and took the chicken off the bill.  I feel bad about giving a three star review but what transpired pretty much ruined my wife's birthday dinner. The waiter and service were excellent as usual.
reviews.author: Arnie L.

reviews.text: It was my first visit but my husband had been there before and took me there for our 10 year wedding anniversary On May 31st.  .  Not only that, but he invited 10 of our friends (my hubby and I spent $250 oursleves). Our food took 3 hours! They never offered any compensation for the long wait or even an apology. Left a message on the comment card. No reponse.  My husband, and friends called the following day and left a message for the manager.  No response.  Called the following Monday, the restaurant is closed till September! Now I understand why the horrible service. They didn't have to deal with us because they wouldn't be back for months! There is much more to complain about but I may run out of room!
reviews.author: Maria D.

reviews.text:
This was our mother day night out for myself and my parents and what an excellent experience we had. 

The restaurant is absolutely beautiful. Even if you aren't sitting out on the patio the views are great. Nice open spaces and huge windows to gaze out on to the valley. The service we had was excellent. Very knowledgeable about what they served, stood around and answered all of our questions. Every member of staff was engaging from bus boys/girls to the hostess. Great warm atmosphere here. 

Food was 5/5. The appetizer we had was the Oysters and they were delicious and very fresh. For entrees I had a Rib-eye, my father had a filet and mother had a tuna dish I believe. Everything was incredible. 

I can't complain about anything here. Great meal. Will definitely return.
reviews.author: Fred K.

reviews.text: I really enjoy this restaurant! We live in the neighborhood and come here often for date night, or business dinners. It flies under the radar, and is therefore usually relatively quiet. Good, high-quality and consistent food, and very good traditional service. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Mike L.

reviews.text:
Was very excited about dining here and afterward about all I can say is that it the food was very underwhelming.  

I lived in Chicago for almost 20 years and hit pretty much all the big steakhouses in that time - Gibsons, Joe's, S&W, Chophouse, and the chains - Mortons/Capital Grill.  I know a good steakhouse and J&G doesn't come close to even the chains.

I had the Six Peppercorn NY Steak with foie gras.  The peppercorn was strong which was fine with me but the meat was very flavorless. Even the foie gras was bland. The slides were small and the fries were cold when served to our table.  

The view is very nice and the wait staff did an excellent job but the kitchen and beef let them down big time.
reviews.author: Jay L.

reviews.text: Great views on the 5th floor at J & G in the Phoenician. I would recommend making a reservation by outside on the patio or by the window for sunset! They had rose and a card ready for our anniversary. The service was great and I would definitely go back. I highly recommend the espresso martini.. best I've ever had!
reviews.author: Megan S.

reviews.text: My brother in law took us here for dinner while we were there on vacation, and I have to say, it was seriously the BEST filet I have ever had in my life!!  All the appetizers were good, and the cheesecake was amazing.  We spent 2 nights out on the rooftop deck for drinks, and the view overlooking that awesome pool was fabulous.  Great drinks and service there too.  I would highly recommend this restaurant and the filet.
reviews.author: Debbie D.

reviews.text:
I decided to surprise my bf with a romantic dinner and couldn't have chosen a better place. Amazing service , food and virgin drinks.

We'll be back this Sunday for some more dessert and virgin drinks. The ambiance and scenery are incredible
reviews.author: Tamika B.

reviews.text: Oh my goodness, the filet Mignon was incredibly tender. I ordered the gratin potatoes and Brussel sporuts, which were amazing, too. Very good meal! Will eat here agin if my boss is paying. (:
reviews.author: Holly M.

reviews.text: We came here to celebrate a birthday! For drinks, I ordered a lemon drop cocktail. I didn't think it was quite strong enough so I switched to a Sauvignon Blanc. To start, I ordered the French Onion Soup and absolutely loved it! For my main course, I shocked myself by ordering chicken at a steakhouse! The Parmesan Crusted Chicken was delicious! It's covered in a perfectly tangy lemon sauce, and served with asparagus. We also ordered some shared sides for the table - creamed spinach, mashed potatoes, macaroni and cheese, and large asparagus. I especially enjoyed the creamed spinach. At the end of the meal, they brought out a little dessert for the birthday girl! The service was a little slow. It seems like restaurants of this caliber usually have multiple servers per table to ensure you are never waiting for a wine refill. But overall, everyone enjoyed their meals!!
reviews.author: Kathleen K.

reviews.text: Amazing! We had the crab cakes, beet and lemon risotto, Brussel sprouts, mushrooms, Parmesan chicken, and for dessert we split the cheesecake and sticky toffee pudding. WOW... I cannot explain to you how great these were. Favorites were the chicken and crab cakes, and both desserts. Amazing and unique flavor, perfect textures and portions. We will most definitely be back!
reviews.author: Amanda G.

reviews.text: On two recent visits the food and service were consistently excellent. Both times those who ordered the tasting menu were satisfied with the selection and value of their 5 course meal served at a leisurely pace. Vegetarian and gluten free options were offered tho the GF bread was a burnt gas-infused toast. Not sure who would order the burger among fine dining options offered just as I don't understand the couple each staring at 15" laptops while seated with a panoramic sunset view.
